original: sa ca neṣṭaḥ, tādṛśasya bodhasyānanubhavāditi padapadārthayoḥ samavāyādivilakṣaṇaḥ kaścana sambandhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ | sa ca jñāta evāpekṣyate, nājñātaḥ; anyathā'jñāte'pi tasminnarthabodhaḥ syāt |
analyzed: sa ca na iṣṭaḥ tādṛśasya bodhasya ananubhavāt iti pada padārthayoḥ samavāya ādi vilakṣaṇaḥ kaścana sambandhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ sa ca jñātaḥ eva apekṣyate na ajñātaḥ anyathā jñāte api tasmin artha bodhaḥ syāt

original: ayameva sambandho vṛttipadena śabdavyāpārādipadena cocyate | evañca śābdabodhaupayikaḥ, arthapratiyogikaḥ padānuyogikaḥ, padapratiyogiko'rthānuyogiko vā sambandho vṛttiḥ | athavā vṛttipadavyavahārthatvaṃ vṛttitvamiti | yena śabdavyāpāreṇa bhaṭityarthabodho bhavati, so'bhidhākhyavyāpāra ityucyate |
analyzed: ayam eva sambandhaḥ vṛtti padena śabda vyāpāra ādi padena ca ucyate evam ca śābdabodha aupayikaḥ artha pratiiogikaḥ pada anuyogikaḥ pada pratiyogikaḥ ṛtha anuyogikaḥ vā sambandhaḥ vṛttiḥ athavā vṛtti pada vyavahā artha tvam vṛtti tvam iti yena śabda vyāpāreṇa bhaṭiti artha bodhaḥ bhavati saḥ ubhidhā ākhya vyāpāraḥ iti ucyate

original: bhaṭṭalollacaprabhṛtayastvabhidhārūpāmekāmeva vṛtiṃ manvate | tayaiva ca sarvavidhasyārthasya bodho bhavati |
analyzed: bhaṭṭa lollaca prabhṛtayaḥ tu abhidhā rūpām ekām eva vṛtim manvate tayā eva ca sarvavidhasya arthasya bodhaḥ bhavati

original: teṣāmayamāśayaḥ -- yathā balavatā prerita eka eva iṣurekenaiva vegākhyena vyāpāreṇa riporvarmacchedam, marmabedaṃ prāṇaharaṇañca vivate, tathā sukaviprayukta eka eva śabda ekenaivābidhākhyavyāpāreṇa padārthopasthitim, anvayabodhaṃ vyaṅgyapratītiñca vidhatte | ato nāsti vācyādanyo'rthastoṣāmiti |
analyzed: teṣām ayam āśayaḥ yathā balavatā preritaḥ ekaḥ eva iṣuḥ ekena eva vega ākhyena vyāpāreṇa ripoḥ varma chedam marma bedam prāṇa haraṇam ca vivate tathā su kavi prayuktaḥ ekaḥ eva śabdaḥ ekena eva abidha ākhya vyāpāreṇa padārtha upasthitim anvaya bodham vyaṅgya pratītim ca vidhatte atas na asti vācyāt anyaḥ ūrthaḥ toṣām iti

original: tathā coktaṃ kāvyaprakāśe -- 'so'yamiṣoriva dīrghadīrghataro'bhidhāvyāpāraḥ' (kā. pra. u. 5, pṛ. 225) iti katipaye vidvāsaḥ | 'gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau bhagīratharathakhātāvacchinnapayaḥ pravāhārtha pratyāyya viratavyāpārāyā abhivāyā gaterabhāvāt tīrabodho na syāditi śabde tadanyamapi lakṣaṇākhyavyāpāraṃ manvate naiyāyikāḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca uktam kāvyaprakāśe saḥ yam iṣoḥ iva dīrgha dīrghataraḥ abhidhā vyāpāraḥ kā pra u 5 pṛ 225 iti katipaye gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ ityādau bhagīratha rathakhāta avacchinna payaḥ pravāha artha pratyāyya virata vyāpārāyāḥ abhivāyāḥ gateḥ abhāvāt tīra bodhaḥ na syāt iti śabde tad anyam api lakṣaṇa ākhya vyāpāram manvate naiyāyikāḥ

original: te cābhidhāṃ saṃketamapi pratipādayanti | tathā coktaṃ śaktivāde --- ' saṃketo lakṣaṇā cārthe padavṛttiḥ ' iti |
analyzed: te ca abhidhām saṃketam api pratipādayanti tathā ca uktam śakti vāde saṃketaḥ lakṣaṇā ca arthe pada vṛttiḥ iti

original: evañca tattatpadena jāyamāne'rthabodhe tattatpadavṛtterjñānāt padārthopasthiti ranvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kāraṇāmati vṛttijñānābhāve śruto'pi śabdo nārthabodhaṃ jayati | ghaṭapaṭādeścākāśādau vṛtterabhāvād naiva tadviṣayako bodhaḥ | eta eva vṛttyā padapratipādya eva padārtha ityabhidhīyate |
analyzed: evam ca tad tad padena jāyamāna īrtha bodhe tad tad pada vṛtteḥ jñānāt padārtha upasthitiḥ ranvaya vyatirekābhyām kāraṇām ati vṛtti jñāna abhāve śrutaḥ api śabdaḥ na artha bodham jayati ghaṭa paṭa ādeḥ ca ākāśa ādau vṛtteḥ abhāvāt na eva tad viṣayakaḥ bodhaḥ ete eva vṛttyā pada pratipādyaḥ eva padārthaḥ iti abhidhīyate

original: tatrādhunikasaṃketaḥ paribhāṣā | tathā cārthabodhakaṃ padaṃ pāribhāṣikam, yathā śāstrakārādisaṃketitanadīvṛddhyādipadam | īśvarasaṃketaḥ śaktiḥ | tathā cārthabodhakaṃ padaṃ vācakam | yathā gotvādiviśiṣṭabodhakaṃ gavādipadam, tadbodhyo'rtho gavādirvācyaḥ | sa eva mukhyārtha ucyate iti gadādharabhaṭṭācāryaḥ |
analyzed: tatra ādhunika saṃketaḥ paribhāṣā tathā ca artha bodhakam padam pāribhāṣikam yathā śāstrakāra ādi saṃketita nadī vṛddhi ādi padam īśvara saṃketaḥ śaktiḥ tathā ca artha bodhakam padam vācakam yathā go tva ādi viśiṣṭa bodhakam gavādi padam tad bodhyaḥ ūrthaḥ gavādiḥ vācyaḥ saḥ eva mukhya arthaḥ ucyate iti gadādhara bhaṭṭa ācāryaḥ

original: jagadīśatakaliṅkārastu -- ubhayāvṛttidharmaviśiṣṭasaṃketavatī sañjñā pāribhāṣikī | yathā''kāśaḍitthādi | śabdavatyākāśe vyaktau nityasaṃketavatī ākāśeti sañjñā | dārumayahastivyavatau ādhunikasaṃketavatī ittheti sañjñā |
analyzed: ubhaya āvṛtti dharma viśiṣṭa saṃketavatī sañjñā pāribhāṣikī yathā ākāśaḥ itthā ādi śabdavati ākāśe vyaktau nitya saṃketavatī ākāśa iti sañjñā dāru maya hasti vyavatau ādhunika saṃketavatī itthā iti sañjñā

original: ākāśaḍitthādisañjñā hi dvitayāvṛttidhamaṇaiva śabdena dārumayahastivṛttitadvyaktitvena ca rūpeṇa śabādaśrayaṃ dārumayahastivṛttitadvyaktitvāśrayaṃ ca pratipādayati |
analyzed: ākāśa ḍittha ādi sañjñā hi dvitaya āvṛtti dhamaṇā eva śabdena dāru maya hasti vṛtti tad vyakti tvena ca rūpeṇa śabāt āśrayam dāru maya hasti vṛtti tad vyakti tva āśrayam ca pratipādayati

original: ghaṭatvādijāteranekavṛtittavād ghaṭatvādijātyāśrayavācakaṃ ghaṭapadaṃ na pāribhāṣikam | ākāśādipadasya śabdāśrayatvavirahite kevale gaganādau saṅketakalpane tu paṭādīnāmapi pāribhāṣikatvaṃ syādityādi | tatrāpi paṭatvavirahite kevale paṭe saṅketasya kalpayituṃ śakyatvāt | evañcātivyāptiḥ pādaleṣṭukā syāt |
analyzed: ghaṭa tva ādi jāteḥ aneka vṛti tta vāt ghaṭa tva ādi jāti āśraya vācakam ghaṭa padam na pāribhāṣikam ākāśa ādi padasya śabda āśraya tva virahite kevale gagana ādau saṅketa kalpane tu paṭa ādīnām api pāribhāṣika tvam syāt ityādi tatra api paṭa tva virahite kevale paṭe saṅketasya kalpayitum śakya tvāt evam ca ativyāptiḥ syāt

original: yadi paṭe saṃketitamapi paṭapadam 'na paṭatvajātiviśiṣṭaśaktimat' ityādiniścayānantaraṃ paṭādipadaśaktigrahāt paṭapadāt paṭatvajātiviśiṣṭasya pasyānanubhavādavaśyaṃ paṭādipadaśaktiḥ kiñcid dharmaviśiṣṭārthanirūpitā, na tu kevalavyaktinirupitā;
analyzed: yadi paṭe saṃketitam api paṭa padam na paṭa tva jāti viśiṣṭa śaktimat ityādi niścaya anantaram paṭa ādi pada śakti grahāt paṭa padāt paṭa tva jāti viśiṣṭasya ananubhavāt avaśyam paṭa ādi pada śaktiḥ kiñcid dharma viśiṣṭa artha nirūpitā na tu kevala vyakti nirupitā

original: anyathā taddharmaprakārakataddhamiviśeṣyakaniścaye sati taddharmābhāvaprakārakataddharmiviśeṣyakajñānaṃ na bhavatīti siddhāntāt 'paṭapadaṃ na paṭatvajātiviśiṣṭaśaktimat' ityākārakaniścayānantaraṃ paṭādipadaśaktigrahāt paṭapadāt paṭasyānubhava āpadyota |
analyzed: anyathā tad dharma prakāraka tad dhami viśeṣyaka niścaye sati tad dharma abhāva prakāraka tad dharmi viśeṣyaka jñānam na bhavati iti siddhāntāt paṭa padam na paṭa tva jāti viśiṣṭa śaktimat iti ākāraka niścaya anantaram paṭa ādi pada śakti grahāt paṭa padāt paṭasya anubhavaḥ āpadya uta

original: tava mate śaktau paṭatvasya prakāratayā'niveśāt, pratibandhyāpratibandhakayoḥ samānaprakārakatvābhāvādityavaśyaṃ paṭatvāvacchinne śaktirabhyupagantavyetīdamucyake, tarhi tulyayuktyā''kāśādipade'pi kathaṃ gajanimīlikā''driyate |
analyzed: tava mate śaktau paṭa tvasya prakāratayā aniveśāt pratibandhya apratibandhakayoḥ samāna prakāraka tva abhāvāt iti avaśyam paṭa tva avacchinne śaktiḥ abhyupagantavyā iti idam ucyake tarhi tulya yuktyā ākāśa ādi pade api katham gajanimīlikā ādriyate

original: tatrāpi śabdavati śaktamapyākāśapadam -- 'na śabādaśrayaśaktimat' iti bādhaniścayadaśāyāmākāśādipadānna śabdāśrayatvena gaganasya pratītiriti śabdāśraya evākāśasya śaktiriti vibhāvyatām |
analyzed: tatra api śabdavati śaktam api ākāśa padam na śabāt āśraya śaktimat iti bādha niścaya daśāyām ākāśa ādi padāt na śabda āśraya tvena gaganasya pratītiḥ iti śabda āśrayaḥ eva ākāśasya śaktiḥ iti vibhāvyatām

original: evañca --- 'paṭatvādyupalakṣite dharmiṇyeva, na tu paṭatvādijātiviśiṣṭe śaktitagrahasya tādrūpyeṇa paṭatvādinā paṭaviṣayakānubhavaṃ prati hetutvād māstu paṭādipadasyāpi paṭatvādyavacchinne śaktiḥ | parantu paṭatvādyupalakṣitavyaktiṣveva itivadato dīdhitikārasyāpi gehe rajanītyaho vidhervaicitryam |'
analyzed: evam ca paṭa tva ādi upalakṣite dharmiṇi eva na tu paṭa tva ādi jāti viśiṣṭe śakti tā grahasya tādrūpyeṇa paṭa tva ādinā paṭa viṣayaka anubhavam prati hetutvāt mā astu paṭa ādi padasya api paṭa tva ādi avacchinne śaktiḥ parantu paṭa tva ādi upalakṣita vyaktiṣu eva iti vadataḥ dīdhiti kārasya api gehe rajani iti aho vidheḥ vaicitryam

original: ekasambandhenānekeṣu vartamānā ye upādhayo dharmāstadviśiṣṭe saṃketavatī sañjñā tvaupādhikī | yathā -- bhūtayūtādīḥ | sā hi sacetanāvṛttiviśeṣaguṇavattvavārtāhārakatvādyanugatopādhipuraskāreṇaivaśakto bhavati | śabdāśrayatvādikantvakhaṇḍatvenopādhirapi nānugato dvitayāvṛttitvāt, ataḥ pāribhāṣike gaganādipade nātiprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: eka sambandhena anekeṣu vartamānāḥ ye upādhayaḥ dharmāḥ tad viśiṣṭe saṃketavatī sañjñā tu aupādhikī yathā bhūta yūta ādīḥ sā hi sa cetanā vṛtti viśeṣa guṇavat tva vārtā hāraka tva ādi anugata upādhi puraskāreṇa eva śaktaḥ bhavati atas pāribhāṣike gagana ādi pade na atiprasaṅgaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ ghaṭapadasyāpi naimittikatvaṃna syāt, pratyuta ghaṭatvājāteravayavasaṃyogaviśeṣavṛttitayaupādhikatvaṃ syāditi cet, iṣṭāpattiḥ | yadi ca svāśrayāśrayatvarūpaparamparāsambandhena vaijātyavattvena śaktaṃ ghaṭapadam, tadā naimittikameveti na vyavahāravirodha ityāha |
analyzed: nanu evam ghaṭa padasya api naimittika tvam na syāt pratyuta ghaṭa tva ajātyāḥ avayava saṃyoga viśeṣa vṛttitayā aupādhika tvam syāt iti ced iṣṭa āpattiḥ yadi ca sva āśraya āśraya tva rūpa paramparā sambandhena vaijātyavat tvena śaktam ghaṭa padam tadā naimittikam eva iti na vyavahāra virodhaḥ iti āha

original: bhartṛ haripadāstu -- yasminnarthe yannāmādhunikasaṃketavat tadeva tatra pāribhāṣikam | evañca yādṛśānupūrvī yādṛśārthaviśeṣyakakiñcijjanyabodhaviṣayatvaprakārakānityasaṃketaviṣayatāviśeṣāvacchedikā tādṛśānupūrvīmattvaṃ tādṛśārthe pāribhāṣitvamiti paryavasitam |
analyzed: bhartṛ hari padāḥ tu yasmin arthe yat nāma ādhunika saṃketa vat tat eva tatra pāribhāṣikam evam ca yādṛśa anupūrvī yādṛśa artha viśeṣyaka kiñcid janya bodha viṣaya tva prakāraka anitya saṃketa viṣayatā viśeṣa avacchedikā tādṛśa ānupūrvīmat tvam tādṛśa arthe pāribhāṣi tvam iti paryavasitam

original: yathā pitrādibhiḥ putrādau saṃketitaṃ caitrādi, yathā vā śāstrakudbhiḥ siddhyabhāvādau saṃketitaṃ pakṣatādi |
analyzed: yathā pitṛ ādibhiḥ putra ādau saṃketitam caitra ādi yathā vā siddhi abhāva ādau saṃketitam pakṣatā ādi

original: yasminnarthe jātyavacchinnaśkatimannāma naimittikam; evañca yādṛśānupūrvīyādṛśārthaviśeṣyakajātyavacchinnasvaśaktinirūpakatāvacchedikā tādṛsānupūrvīmattvaṃ tādṛśārthanaimittikatvaṃ payaivasitam | yathā - gavi gonāma, gavaye ca gavayādināma | yatrārthe yadupādhyavacchinnaśaktitamannāma tadaupādhikam |
analyzed: yasmin arthe jāti avacchinna śkatimat nāma naimittikam evam ca yādṛśa anupūrvī yādṛśa artha viśeṣyaka jāti avacchinna sva śakti nirūpaka tā avacchedikā tādṛśa ānupūrvīmat tvam tādṛśa artha naimittika tvam yathā gavi go nāma gavaye ca gavaya ādi nāma yatra arthe yat upādhi avacchinna śaktitamat nāma tat aupādhikam

original: tathā ca yādṛśānupūrvī yādṛśārthaviśeṣyakasakhaṇḍadharmavaccinnaśkatinirūpakatāvacchedikā tādṛśānupūrvīmattvaṃ phalitam | yathā''kāśapaśvādi |
analyzed: tathā ca yādṛśa anupūrvī yādṛśa artha viśeṣyaka sakhaṇḍa dharma vat cit naśkati nirūpaka tā avacchedikā tādṛśa ānupūrvīmat tvam phalitam yathā ākāśa paśu ādi

original: nanu ādhunikasaṃketasyāpiśaktimattvāt pāribāṣikacaitrādiśabdānāṃ naimittikatvāpattiḥ, nadīvṛddhyādiśabdānāmaupādhiktavāpatiśaaca | iṣṭāpattau ca tena rūpeṇa vibhāgāsambhavaḥ, mithoviruddharmasyaiva vibhājakatāvacchedakatvāditi cet na; saṃketasya śaktitvenādhunikasya saṃketasya śaktitvābhāvāt | tathāhi ---
analyzed: nanu ādhunika saṃketasya api śaktimat tvāt pāribāṣika caitra ādi śabdānām naimittika tva āpattiḥ nadī vṛddhi ādi śabdānām iṣṭa āpattau ca tena rūpeṇa vibhāga asambhavaḥ mithas viruddha dharmasya eva vibhājaka tā avacchedaka tvāt iti ced na saṃketasya śakti tvena ādhunikasya saṃketasya śakti tva abhāvāt tathā hi

original: ājānikaścādhunikaḥ saṃketo dvividho mataḥ |

original: nitya ājānikastatra yā śaktirityabhidhīyate ||

original: kādācitkastvādhunikaḥ śāstrakārādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ||
analyzed: kādācitkaḥ tu ādhunikaḥ śāstra kāra ādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ

original: tatra = tayormadhye, nityaḥ saṃketaḥ ājānikaḥ = na janirutpatiryasyāsau ajaniḥ, ajanirevājānikaḥ, svārthe ikaṇitiājānikaśabdo yaugikaḥ | anye tu, ājātikaḥ kālatvavyāpaka ityarthaḥ | tathā cājānikaḥ śabdaḥ pāribhāṣika ityāhuḥ | tat na ; yaugikasambhave pāribhāṣikakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt |
analyzed: tatra tayoḥ madhye nityaḥ saṃketaḥ ājānikaḥ na janiḥ utpatiḥ yasya asau ajaniḥ ajaniḥ eva ājānikaḥ svārthe yaugikaḥ anye tu ājātikaḥ kāla tva vyāpakaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā ca ājānikaḥ śabdaḥ pāribhāṣikaḥ iti āhuḥ tat na yaugika sambhave pāribhāṣika kalpanāyāḥ anyāyya tvāt

original: na ca prāgabhāvāpratiyogitve sati dhvaṃsāpratiyogitvarūpasya nityatvasya yogālabhyatvena tadbodhane tasya kathaṃ yaugikatvamiti vācyam, prāgabhāvātiriktasyānutpannavastuno dhvaṃsāpratiyogitviyamāt | nityapadasyaivānupannapatatvād vā | na ca tayorekārthatvena paunaruktyam, ājādika ityasyājānikaśabdapratipādyaparatvāt |
analyzed: na ca prāgabhāva apratiyogi tve sati dhvaṃsa apratiyogi tva rūpasya nitya tvasya yoga alabhya tvena tad bodhane tasya katham yaugika tvam iti vācyam prāgabhāva atiriktasya anutpanna vastunaḥ dhvaṃsa apratiyogi tva iyamāt nitya padasya eva anupannapatatvāt vā na ca tayoḥ ekārtha tvena paunaruktyam ājādikaḥ iti asya ājānika śabda pratipādya paratvāt

analyzed: ākhyāta artha āśrayaḥ iti mīmāṃsaka uktam iti adhikaḥ pāṭha kha matam tu na yukta ām ante kṛti ca doṣa āpatteḥ kṛtiḥ ityādi ca kṛñaḥ kṛtau nirūḍha lakṣaṇā taṇḍula krayaṇa ādeḥ ca na pāka ādi anukūla tvam anukūla tā viśeṣaṇasya eva saṃsarga tvāt na pacati doṣa iti akiḥ pāṭha kha

original: karoterapyevam, vātarogādinā kampamāne caitre spandānukūlavijātīyavāyusaṃyogarūpavyāpāravatyapi 'nā'haṃ spandaṃ karomi, api tu vātarogeṇa maccharīraṃ kampate' iti pratītyā karoteryatnārthatvasyaivaucityāt, paṭāṅ kurayoḥ kṛtākṛtavyavahārācca | bījādināṅkuraḥ kṛta ityādāvanukūlavyāpāre kṛño lakṣaṇā | bhāvayatīti vivaraṇamapi kṛtyabhiprāyakameva |
analyzed: karoteḥ api evam vāta roga ādinā kampamāne caitre spanda anukūla vijātīya vāyu saṃyoga rūpa vyāpāravati api na aham spandam karomi api tu vāta rogeṇa mad śarīram kampate iti pratītyā karoteḥ yatna artha tvasya eva aucityāt paṭa aṅ kurayoḥ kṛta akṛta vyavahārāt ca bīja ādinā aṅkuraḥ kṛtaḥ ityādau anukūla vyāpāre kṛñaḥ lakṣaṇā bhāvayati iti vivaraṇam api kṛti abhiprāyakam eva

original: na ca kṛño yatnārthakatve yataterivākarmakatāpattiḥ, śabda śaktisvabhāvāt |

original: yadvā, kaॉña utpattyanukalā kṛtirarthaḥ, yataterhi kṛtirarthaḥ, yataterhi kṛtirevetyadoṣaḥ | na caivamutpādayatītyasyotpattiṃ karotīti vivaramasaṃgataṃ syāt, utpatterūtpattyabhāvāditi vācyam, tatra vyāpāramātre lakṣaṇāṅgīkārāt |

original: na ca yatnatvasyākhyātāvācyanivṛttijīvanayoniyatnasādhāraṇatayā śakyatāvacchedakatvāsambhava iti vācyam, iṣṭasādhanatājñānajanyāvacchedakapravṛttitvajātirevākhyātapravṛttinimittatvopagamādadoṣaḥ | ata eveśvarakṛterjanyamātrajanakatve'pi 'īśvaraḥ pacati, īśvaro bhuṅakte' ityādayo na prayogāḥ |

original: 'īśvako vedaṃ vakti' ityādau tu 'caitraḥ pacati' itivanna svārasikaḥ prayogaḥ | na ca 'karoti' ityādau tu vyāpāre lakṣaṇā, tasmād yatna evākhyātārthaḥ |

original: ata eva 'caitra eva pacati, nācetanaṃ kāṣṭādi' iti svārasiko vyavahāraḥ | 'kāṣṭhāni pacanti' iti tu 'caitraḥ pacati' iti tu 'caitraḥ pacati' itivanna svārasikaḥ prayogaḥ | na ca 'karoti' ityādau dvedhā yatnabodhāpattiḥ, 'dvau' ityādivadupapatteḥ | 'ratho gacchati' ityādau ca kriyānukūlavyāpāre lakṣaṇā |

original: kriyāyāśca sāmānādhikaraṇyānukūlatvābhyāṃ vyāpāre'nvayaḥ, vyutpattivaicitryāt | ato nānyadīyagamanānukūlatodanādilakṣaṇavyāpāravati 'gacchati' iti prayogaḥ | anukūlatāviśeṣasyaiva vā sambandhatvānnātiprasaṅgaḥ |

original: yadi tu 'nidrāti' ityādau mitthānāḍīmanoyogarūpanidrānukūvyāpārāprasiddiḥ, 'ratho gacchati' ityādāvapi tathānanubhavaścetyucyate, tarhi 'jānāti,gacchati, yatate, dveṣṭi, karoti, nidrāti' ityādāvaśrayatve lakṣaṇā |

original: nanu dhātvarthasyaivāśrayatāsambandhena prathamāntārthe'nvayostu, kiṃ lakṣaṇāyā ? kiñca, lakṣaṇāpakṣe āśrayatvāya sambandhasyādhikasya 'jānāti' ityādau bhānasvīkāreṇa gauravam |

original: na ca 'taṇḍulaḥ pacati' ityādau taṇḍulādeḥ karmatāsambandhena pākādāvanvayabodhavāraṇāya nāmārthadhātvarthayorbhedena sākṣādanvayasyāvyutpattyā na tathā bodhasambhava iti vācyam, prātipadikārthaprakārakriyābodhasyāvyutpannatve'pi kriyāprakārakaprātipadikārthaviśeṣyakabodhasyāvyutpannatve mānābhāvāditi cet, na;
analyzed: na ca taṇḍulaḥ pacati ityādau taṇḍula ādeḥ karmatā sambandhena pāka ādau anvaya bodha vāraṇāya nāma artha dhātvarthayoḥ bhedena sākṣāt anvayasya avyutpattyā na tathā bodha sambhavaḥ iti vācyam prātipadika artha prakāra kriyā bodhasya avyutpanna tve pi kriyā prakāraka prātipadika artha viśeṣyaka bodhasya avyutpanna tve māna abhāvāt iti cet na

original: 'ghaṭaḥ karoti' ityādau 'kṛtikarmībhūto ghaṭaḥ' ityanvayabodhavāraṇāya kriyāprakārakanāmārthabodhasyāpyavyutpannatvāt | sambandhabhānagauravaṃ tu na doṣāvaham, prāmāṇikatvāt |

original: astu vā tathā, varttamānatvādyanvayastu sarvathedṛśe viṣaye dhātvartha eva,na tvāśrayatvādau | jñānādyasattve'pi svarūpasambandhaviśeṣarūpasyātiriktasya vāśrayatvādeḥ sambandhe'sya sattve jānātītyādiprayogāpatteḥ | jñānādiviśiṣṭe āśrayatvādau tadanvaye tu viśeṣaṇajñānādāvapi tadanvayasyāvaśyakatvena tasyaiva svīkāraucityāt |
analyzed: astu vā tathā varttamāna tva ādi anvayaḥ tu sarvathā īdṛśe viṣaye dhātvarthe eva na tu āśraya tva ādau jñāna ādi asattve pi svarūpa sambandha viśeṣa rūpasya atiriktasya vā āśraya tva ādeḥ sattve jānāti ityādi prayoga āpatteḥ jñāna ādi viśiṣṭe āśraya tva ādau tad anvaye tu viśeṣaṇa jñāna ādau api tad anvayasya āvaśyaka tvena tasya eva svīkāra aucityāt

original: na ca yatnasyākhyātārthatve "karttari laḥ" ityādyanuśāsanavirodhaḥ, kṛtyabhidhānenaiva prathamāntārthaviśeṣaṇatayā kṛtyanvayena kṛtiviśiṣṭasya kartturbodhanirvāhe lasya tadbodhakatvād na tadvirodhaḥ, 'laḥ karmaṇi' ityatra bodhakatāyā eva saptamyarthatvāt, na tu vācakatā tadarthaḥ, gauraveṇa viśiṣṭadharmiṇi śakterbādhāt |
analyzed: na ca yatnasya ākhyāta artha tve karttari laḥ ityādi anuśāsana virodhaḥ kṛti abhidhānena eva prathamā anta artha viśeṣaṇa tayā kṛti anvayena kṛti viśiṣṭasya karttuḥ bodha nirvāhe lasya tad bodhaka tvāt na tad virodhaḥ laḥ karmaṇi iti atra bodhaka tāyāḥ eva saptamī artha tvāt na tu vācaka tā tad arthaḥ gauraveṇa viśiṣṭa dharmiṇi śakteḥ bādhāt

original: na ca 'caitraḥ pacati' ityādau bhinnābhyāṃ rūpābhyāmekadharmibodhakatvalakṣaṇasāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavavirodha iti vācyam, tathānanubhavāt, tādātmyānantarbhāveṇa svārthānvitārthabodhakatvasyaiva sāmānādhikaraṇyasya pratīteḥ |
analyzed: na ca caitraḥ pacati ityādau bhinnābhyām rūpābhyām eka dharmi bodhaka tva lakṣaṇa sāmānādhikaraṇya anubhava virodhaḥ iti vācyam tathā ananubhavāt tādātmya anantarbhāveṇa svārtha anvita artha bodhaka tvasya eva sāmānādhikaraṇyasya pratīteḥ

original: astu vā tathā sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ lakṣaṇayā, śaktistu lāghavād yatna eva, ata eva "yuṣmadyupapade samānādhikaraṇe" [ 1|4|105 ] ityādīnāṃ nānupapattiḥ | ata eva ca 'kiṃ karoti' iti praśne 'pacati' ityevottare datte devadattādipadābhāve'pi manasopasthite karttari naikatvasaṃśayaḥ, lakṣaṇayopasthate dharmiṇi saṅkhyānvayenādoṣāt |
analyzed: astu vā tathā sāmānādhikaraṇyam lakṣaṇayā śaktiḥ tu lāghavāt yatne eva atas eva yuṣmadi upapade samāna adhikaraṇe ityādīnām nā anupapattiḥ atas eva ca kim karoti iti praśne pacati iti eva uttare datte devadatta ādi pada abhāve pi manasā upasthite karttari nā ekatva saṃśayaḥ lakṣaṇayā upasthate dharmiṇi saṅkhyā anvayena adoṣāt

original: 'pacati' ityādau kālānvayastu kṛtāveva, na tu dhātvarthe, yatnaśunye'pi puṣpe tadadhīnāgnisaṃyogādirūpacyādyarthasya vidyamānatve 'ayaṃ na pacati' iti prayogāt, 'ayaṃ pacati' ityukte idānīmayaṃ pākayatnavānna veti saṃśayanivṛttesca | jānātītyādau dhātvartha eva tadanvayadhrauvyāt |
analyzed: pacati ityādau kāla anvayaḥ tu kṛtau eva na tu dhātvarthe puṣpe tad adhīna agni saṃyoga ādi rūpacī ādi arthasya vidyamāna tve ayam na pacati iti prayogāt ayam pacati iti ukte idānīm ayam pāka yatnavān na vā iti saṃśaya nivṛtteḥ ca jānāti ityādau dhātvarthe eva tad anvaya dhrauvyāt

original: pacatītyādāvapi tathaiva, yatnanivṛttau pākānuvṛttau 'ayaṃ na pacati' iti tu na bhavatyeva pacatītyasyaiva darśanācca |

original: kriyānāmiyamatyantāparidṛṣṭā, na śakyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitum' iti sā [ sarvāpya ?] numānagamyeti cet, naḥ tadanukūlaśaktimatāṃ vyāpārāviṣṭānāṃ sādhanānāṃ pārokṣyasyeha vivakṣitatvāt | tena kriyānāviṣṭasādhanamātrapratyakṣe'pi liṭ, yathā -- papāceti |
analyzed: kriyānām iyam atyanta a paridṛṣṭā na śakyā piṇḍībhūtā nidarśayitum iti sā sarvā api a numāna gamyā iti ced naḥ tad anukūla śaktimatām vyāpāra āviṣṭānām sādhanānām pārokṣyasya iha vivakṣita tvāt tena kriyā an āviṣṭa sādhana mātra pratyakṣe api liṭ yathā papāca iti

original: evaṃ svavyāpārasay varttamānasya vāyasaṅgādinā svayamapratisandhāne tattatkāryeṇānumitau sakhyādyuktyā vā jñāne bhavatyeva liṭ, yathā -- 'bahu jagadapurastāt tasya ma.tā kilāham' iti, 'vyātene kiraṇāvalīmudayanaḥ' ityapi "niṣṭhā" [ 3|2|102 ] iti sūtrabhāṣyoktarītyā bhūtvānadyatanatvaparotratvānāmāropeṇopapannam |
analyzed: evam varttamānasya vāyasaṅga ādinā svayam apratisandhāne tad tad kāryeṇa anumitau sakhi ādi uktyā vā jñāne bhavati eva liṭ yathā bahu jagat a purastāt tasya matā kila aham iti vyātene kiraṇāvalīm udayanaḥ iti api niṣṭhā iti sūtra bhāṣya ukta rītyā bhūtvā anadyatanatva parotratvānām āropeṇa upapannam

original: āropaphalaṃ tu granthe'ti sukaratvaśīghraniṣpādyatvādipratyāpannamaiva | tatphalaṃ tu tatkālikādhyetṛṇāṃ svaśiṣyāṇāmarthapravivekādiphalakamamuṃ granthaṃ jñātumutsukānāmāhlādanameva | parokṣatvāropo'thaitatphalaka eva |
analyzed: āropa phalam tu grantha iti sukaratva śīghra niṣpādya tva ādi pratyāpannam ā eva tad phalam tu tad kālikā adhyetṛṇām sva śiṣyāṇām artha praviveka ādi phalakam amum grantham jñātum utsukānām āhlādanam eva parokṣa tva āropaḥ utha etad phalakaḥ eva

original: evaṃ sūkṣmakālena kariṣyāmi yatnakaraṇakāle svenāpi sākṣātkartumaśakyamityevaṃ bodhanādanāyāsena granthakaramamapi vyaṅgyam | sūryopamāpyetatpoṣikaiva | itaragranthebhyo'smin granthe, tatkartṛbhyaśca svasmin vyatireko'pi vyaṅgyaḥ | bhaviṣyataḥ prayogakāle vāstavameva porakṣatvamiti na tadaṃśe āropāpekṣetyapi vadanti |
analyzed: evam sūkṣma kālena kariṣyāmi yatna karaṇa kāle svena api sākṣāt kartum aśakyam iti evam bodhanāt anāyāsena granthaka ramam api vyaṅgyam sūryopamā api etad poṣikā eva itara granthebhyaḥ asmin granthe tad kartṛbhyaḥ ca svasmin vyatirekaḥ api vyaṅgyaḥ bhaviṣyataḥ prayoga kāle vāstavam eva porakṣa tvam iti na tad aṃśe āropa apekṣā iti api vadanti

original: kecitu kriyayāmeva pārokṣyam, na ca sarvāpi sā parokṣaivetyavyāvartakaṃ tat, avayavaśaḥ pratyakṣatvāt | na [ca] pratyekaṃ na kriyātvam, tāvatāpi dhātvarthatvakṣateḥ, kriyātvasyāvayavāvayavisādhāraṇatvācca |
analyzed: kecid tu kriyayām eva pārokṣyam na ca sarvā api sā parokṣā eva iti avyāvartakam tat avayavaśas pratyakṣa tvāt na ca pratyekam na kriyā tvam tāvatā api dhātvartha tva kṣateḥ kriyā tvasya avayava avayavi sādhāraṇa tvāt ca

original: kiñca, dhātorityasya dhātvarthe lakṣaṇāyāṃ svavācyatvaṃ sambandhaḥ, sādhanalakṣaṇāyāṃ svavācyasādhanatvaṃ sambandha iti gauravam | avayavāśrayatvādeva ca devadattasya kartṛ tvādi saṅgacchata ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: kiñca dhātoḥ iti asya dhātvarthe lakṣaṇāyām sva vācya tvam sambandhaḥ sādhana lakṣaṇāyām sva vācya sādhana tvam sambandhaḥ iti gauravam avayava āśraya tvāt eva ca devadattasya kartṛ tva ādi saṅgacchate iti āhuḥ

original: anadyatanatvaṃ cātītarātreḥ paścārdhenāgāminyāḥ pūrvārdhena ca kālo'dyatanaḥ, tadbhinnatvam | evamanadyatane bhaviṣyati luṭ, bhaviṣyatsāmānye lṛṭ ; ityādi tattadanuśāsanavalād vyavahārācca bodhyam |
analyzed: anadyatana tvam ca atīta rātreḥ paśca ardhena āgāminyāḥ pūrva ardhena ca kāla udyatanaḥ tad bhinna tvam evam anadyatane bhaviṣyati luṭ bhaviṣyat sāmānye lṛṭ ityādi tad tad anuśāsana valāt vyavahārāt ca bodhyam

original: atha vidhyādau vihitaliṅarthe kḷñciducyate
analyzed: atha vidhi ādau vihita liṅ arthe kḷñcit ucyate

original: tatra vidhiḥ = preraṇam, yathā nikṛṣṭasya bhṛtyādeḥ | nimantraṇam = niyogakaraṇam, āvaśyake śrāddhabhojanādau pravarttanam | āmantraṇam = kāmacārānujñā | aghīṣṭaḥ = satkārapūrvako vyāpāraḥ | taccatuṣṭayānusyūtapravartanāsāmānyaṃ vidhyarthaḥ | vidhyādisūtre caturṇāṃ pṛthagupādānaṃ spaṣṭārtham | pravartanātvaṃ śakyatāvacchedakam |
analyzed: tatra vidhiḥ preraṇam yathā nikṛṣṭasya bhṛtya ādeḥ nimantraṇam niyoga karaṇam āvaśyake śrāddha bhojana ādau pravarttanam āmantraṇam kāmacāra anujñā aghīṣṭaḥ satkāra pūrvakaḥ vyāpāraḥ tad catuṣṭaya anusyūta pravartanā sāmānyam vidhi arthaḥ vidhi ādi sūtre caturṇām pṛthak upādānam spaṣṭa artham pravartanā tvam śakyatā avacchedakam

original: tadatiriktāṃśasya pramāṇāntaralakṣyatvānna śakyatvam |
analyzed: tad atirikta aṃśasya pramāṇa antara lakṣya tvāt na śakya tvam

original: na ca "preṣātisargaprāptakāleṣu kṛtyāśca" [ 3|3|163 ] iti sūtre praiṣādigrahaṇaṃ vyartham, nimantraṇādau kṛtyābhāvārthaṃ tasyāvaśyakatvāt | loḍvidhānaṃ prāptakālārtham pravartanā ca prakṛtyanukūlo vyāpāro vaktrabhiprāyaḥ | sa cecchāviśeṣarūpaḥ, icchāgatavaijātyasya śakyatāvacchedakatvena lāghavāt |
analyzed: na ca preṣa atisarga prāpta kāleṣu kṛtyāḥ ca iti sūtre praiṣa ādi grahaṇam vyartham nimantraṇa ādau kṛtyā bhāva artham tasya āvaśyaka tvāt loṭ vidhānam prāpta kāla artham pravartanā ca prakṛti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ vaktṛ abhiprāyaḥ sa ca icchā viśeṣa rūpaḥ icchā gata vaijātyasya śakya tā avacchedaka tvena lāghavāt

original: ata eva prārthanasya pṛthag grahaṇ | tatra vaktricchāsattve'pi tasyāniyamenāpravartakatayā'tra vaijātyaniveśasyāvaśyakatvāt | icchā ca loke paruśaniṣṭhā, vede tvātīśvaraniṣṭhaiva, 'naiveśvara ajñāpayati, nāpidhmasūtrakārāḥ paṭhanti' iti bhāṣyāt | takṣa hīśvarājñā vedaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva prārthanasya tatra vaktṛ icchā sattve pi tasya aniyamena apravartaka tayā atra vaijātya niveśasya āvaśyaka tvāt icchā ca loke paruśa niṣṭhā vede tvā atīśvara niṣṭhā eva na eva īśvara ajñāpayati hi īśvara ājñā vedaḥ

original: pravartakatvaṃ ca svātāntrye sati tādṛśarthabodhakaliṅādyuccārayitṛtvādikameva |
analyzed: pravartaka tvam ca svātāntrye sati tādṛś artha bodhaka liṅ ādi uccārayitṛ tva ādikam eva

original: yattu, iṣṭasādhanatvameva savayāpāraḥ, iṣṭasādhanatājñānasya pravṛttisāmānye hetutvāvadhāraṇena tasyaiva vācyatvaucityāt | iṣṭaṃ ca kvacit sākṣātkartureva kvacit paramparā | ata e ca 'ācāryaprerito'haṃ gāmānayāmi' ityādāvācāryādeḥ pravartakatvavyavahāraḥ saṅgacchate |
analyzed: yat tu iṣṭa sādhanatvam eva iṣṭa sādhanatā jñānasya pravṛtti sāmānye hetutva avadhāraṇena tasya eva vācyatva aucityāt iṣṭam ca kvacid sākṣāt kartuḥ eva kvacid paramparā atas ca ācārya preritā uham gām ānayāmi ityādau ācārya ādeḥ pravartaka tva vyavahāraḥ saṅgacchate

original: bhavatpreraṇayā'hamadhyāpayāmi, na kiñcinmameṣṭamiti vyavahārastu na me sākṣāt kiñcidiṣṭamityevamparaḥ |
analyzed: bhavat preraṇayā aham adhyāpayāmi na kiñcid mama iṣṭam iti vyavahāraḥ tu na me sākṣāt kiñcid iṣṭam iti evamparaḥ

original: pravarttakatvañca pavṛttijanakeṣṭasādhanatvabodhaliṅādyuccārayitatvādikameva | na ca rājapreritapadātestādṛśaliṅādyuccārayitṛtvena pravartakatvāpattiḥ, na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, 'padātiprerito'haṃ nedaṃ kurve, kintu rājapreritaḥ' iti vyavāhārānāpatteḥ, iti vācyam,svātantrye satīti viśeṣaṇāt | piśunapreritarājñyapi svātantryamastyeva |
analyzed: pravarttaka tvam ca pavṛtti janaka iṣṭa sādhanatva bodha liṅ ādi uccārayita tva ādikam eva na ca rāja prerita padāteḥ tādṛśa liṅ ādi uccārayitṛ tvena pravartaka tva āpattiḥ na ca iṣṭa āpattiḥ padāti preritā uham na idam kurve kintu rāja preritaḥ iti vyavāhāra anāpatteḥ iti vācyam svātantrye sati iti viśeṣaṇāt piśuna prerita rājñi api svātantryam asti eva

original: balātkāreṇa gurvādipreritabālādyadhyāpane'pi tadabhāvaprayuktagurvādikrodhajanyatāḍanābhāva eveṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: balātkāreṇa guru ādi prerita bāla ādi adhyāpane pi tad abhāva prayukta guru ādi krodha janya tāḍana abhāvaḥ eva iṣṭaḥ

original: yadyapi "svaritañi taḥ" [ 1|3|72 ] ityādau kriyāphalaśabdena pratyāsattyādhātvarthabhūtameva phalaṃ gṛhyate, tathāpīha tathāgrahaṇe na kiñcinmānam | ta ceṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ na phravarttakam, aniṣṭasādhane udāsīne ca 'kaṣṭaṃ karma' iti nyāyena dveṣādapravṛtteriti vācyam,āntarālikaśrame dveṣābhāvadaśāyā tadajñānadaśāyāṃ vā pravṛttyāpatteḥ |
analyzed: yadi api taḥ ityādau kriyā phala śabdena pratyāsattyā dhātvartha bhūtam eva phalam gṛhyate tathā api iha tathā grahaṇe na kiñcid mānam ca iṣṭa sādhanatā jñānam na aniṣṭa sādhane udāsīne ca kaṣṭam karma iti nyāyena dveṣāt apravṛtteḥ iti vācyam āntarālika śrame dveṣa abhāva daśāyā tad ajñāna daśāyām vā pravṛtti āpatteḥ

original: na ca cikīrṣāyāṃ satyāmiṣṭāpattiriti vācyam, iṣṭasādhanatvajñānaṃ vinā tasyā evābhāvāt |
analyzed: na ca cikīrṣāyām satyām iṣṭa āpattiḥ iti vācyam iṣṭa sādhanatva jñānam vinā tasyāḥ eva abhāvāt

original: evañceṣṭasādhanatvameva liṅaśakyam | tacca svargādisādhanatvenaiva, tena rūpeṇa jñānasyaiva pravarttakatvāt ; na tviṣṭatvena, tasya svarūpasata eva hetutvena tajjñānānapekṣaṇāt, bahuvittavyayāyāsasādhye āmuṣmike ca viśiṣya tajjñānaṃ vinā pravṛttyabhāvācca |
analyzed: evam ca iṣṭa sādhanatvam eva liṅ śakyam tat ca svarga ādi sādhanatvena eva tena rūpeṇa jñānasya eva pravarttaka tvāt na tu iṣṭa tvena tasya svarūpa sataḥ eva hetu tvena tad jñāna anapekṣaṇāt bahu vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhye āmuṣmike ca viśiṣya tad jñānam vinā pravṛtti abhāvāt ca

original: tatra nānārthatvaparihārāya tadādāviva śakyatāvakchedakānāmanugamikeccheti bodhyam | yathā buddhiviṣayatvarūpeṇopastitaghaṭatvapaṭatvādiśāliṣu buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakavati tadādipadaṃ śaktamityeva tadādeḥ śaktigrahaḥ | buddhiviṣayatvamupasthitāvupalakṣaṇayānugamakamātram, na tu tadaṃśe śaktiḥ |
analyzed: tatra nānārthatva parihārāya tad ādau iva śakyatā avakchedakānām anugamikā icchā iti bodhyam yathā buddhi viṣayatva rūpeṇa upastita ghaṭa tva paṭa tva ādi śāliṣu buddhi viṣayatā avacchedakavati tad ādi padam śaktam iti eva tad ādeḥ śakti grahaḥ buddhi viṣayatvam upasthitau upalakṣaṇayā anugamaka mātram na tu tad aṃśe śaktiḥ

original: evamihāpi liṅādiricchāviṣayatāvacchedakasvargatvādivatsādhanatvaśakta ityeva śaktigrahaḥ |
analyzed: evam iha api liṅ ādiḥ icchā viṣayatā avacchedaka svarga tva ādi vat sādhanatva śaktaḥ iti eva śaktigrahaḥ

original: na caivaṃ tāvatā tadādau buddhiḥ, iheccaā vā praviṣṭā | padārthopasthirapi tadādau prakaraṇādimahimnā buddhiviṣayatāvacchedakaghaṭatvādinovehāpi samabhivyāhṛtasvargapadamahimnā svargādisādhanamitye, na tu buddhīcchayoḥ śabdabodhe bhānam |
analyzed: na ca evam tāvatā tad ādau buddhiḥ vā praviṣṭā padārtha upasthiḥ api tad ādau prakaraṇa ādi mahimnā buddhi viṣayatā avacchedaka ghaṭa tva ādinā u vā iha api samabhivyāhṛta svarga pada mahimnā svarga ādi sādhanam itye na tu buddhi icchayoḥ śabda bodhe bhānam

original: evañca viśiṣyeṣṭavācchedakasvargatvādiprakāreṇa śābdabodhotpattyā vidhivākyāt pravartakajñānanirvāhaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca viśiṣya iṣṭa vā chedaka svarga tva ādi prakāreṇa śābda bodha utpattyā vidhi vākyāt pravartaka jñāna nirvāhaḥ

original: evañca icchāviṣayatāvacchedakatvopalakṣitasvargatvādiviśiṣṭasādhanatve vidheśaktiriti phalitam |
analyzed: evam ca icchā viṣayatā avacchedaka tva upalakṣita svarga tva ādi viśiṣṭa sādhanatve vidheḥ śaktiḥ iti phalitam

original: na caitasyāpi svargakāmādipadāllābhena na tatra śaktiḥ, kāmāntapadāt svargādyupastitāvapi sādhanatvabodhakābhāvāt, viśvajidādau tatpadasamabhivyāhārasyāpyabhāvācca | sāmānyata iṣṭasādhanatvamātre jñāte'pi paścādviśeṣajijñāsāyāṃ tattatpadakalpaneti tvanyadetat |
analyzed: na ca etasya api svarga kāma ādi padāt lābhena na tatra śaktiḥ kāma anta padāt svarga ādi upastitau api sādhanatva bodhaka abhāvāt viśvajit ādau tad pada samabhivyāhārasya api abhāvāt ca sāmānyatas iṣṭasādhanatva mātre jñāte api paścāt viśeṣa jijñāsāyām tad tad pada kalpanā iti tu anyat etat

original: balavadaniṣṭānubandhitvajñānaṃ tu na pravartakam, vahvāyāsasādhye pravṛttyanāpatteḥ | tatra bahutaraduḥ khasyāpi jāyamānatvāt, alpaduḥkhasyāpi kutaścid balavattvenānugatabalavattvasya durvacatvācca | na caivaṃ madhuviṣasampṛktānnabhojanādau pravṛttyāpattiḥ, tattadviṣayakabalavadadveṣasya svātantryeṇa pratibandhakatvenādoṣāt |
analyzed: balavat aniṣṭa anubandhi tva jñānam tu na pravartakam vahu āyāsa sādhye pravṛtti anāpatteḥ tatra bahutara duḥkhasya api jāyamāna tvāt alpa duḥkhasya api kutaścid balavat tvena anugata balavat tvasya durvaca tvāt ca na ca evam madhu viṣa sampṛkta anna bhojana ādau pravṛtti āpattiḥ tad tad viṣayaka balavat adveṣasya svātantryeṇa pratibandhaka tvena adoṣāt

original: ata evāntarālikaśrame balavaddveṣavān jyotiṣṭomādau na pravartate, anyastu pravartata eva |
analyzed: atas eva āntarālika śrame balavat dveṣavān jyotiṣṭoma ādau na pravartate anyaḥ tu pravartate eva

original: etena kṛtisādhyatavajñānaṃ pravartakamitayapāstam | kṛtyasādhye candramaṇḍalādigrahaṇe pravṛttyabhāvaśca tata iṣṭābhāvena vṛthāśramajanakatayā dveṣāt | kḷñcāśaktasyāpi yatkiñcitkṛtisādhye pravṛttyāpattyā madaṃśaviśiṣṭaṃ pravartakaṃ vācyam |
analyzed: etena kṛti sādhya tava jñānam pravartakam iti apāstam kṛtya sādhye candra maṇḍala ādi grahaṇe pravṛtti abhāvaḥ ca tatas iṣṭa abhāvena vṛthāśrama janaka tayā dveṣāt kḷñca aśaktasya api yat kiñcid kṛti sādhye pravṛtti āpattyā mad aṃśa viśiṣṭam pravartakam vācyam

original: evañca vedena tathābodhayitumaśakyatvānna tacchakyam | yāgo matkṛtisādhyaḥ, matekṛtisādhyatvavirodhidharmānadhikaraṇatvāt ; ityādyanumānarūpalaukikapramāṇenāpi tadgrahasambhavenānvayalabhyatvācca | yāgo matkṛtisādhyo bhavatviti cikīrṣā tu lokatastadavagamenaiva siddhā |
analyzed: evam ca vedena tathā ābodhayitum aśakya tvāt na tat śakyam yāgaḥ mad kṛti sādhyaḥ mate kṛti sādhya tva virodhi dharma anadhikaraṇa tvāt ityādi anumāna rūpa laukika pramāṇena api tad graha sambhavena anvaya labhya tvāt ca yāgaḥ mad kṛti sādhyaḥ bhavatu iti cikīrṣā tu lokataḥ tad avagamena eva siddhā

original: atheṣṭasādhanatvasya vidhyarthatve 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' ityādau tṛtīyā na syāt, karaṇānabhidhāna eva tadvidhānāt | na ca yajyarthagatasādhanatve'bhihite'pi tadviśaṣajyotiṣṭomādikārthagatasyānabhidhānena tṛtīyā siddhiḥ, jyotiṣṭhomayajyarthayorabhedāt | ata eva 'devadattaḥ pacati' ityādau devadattapadādapi na tṛtīyā |

original: sā ca pravartanā liṅdyotyā vācyā vā ? tatrādye upapattiḥ, tasyāḥ pratyayārthatve kartrādīnāmarthānāṃ lakārāntare sāvakāśānāṃ vidhyādayo vācakāḥ syuḥ |
analyzed: sā ca pravartanā liṅ dyotyā vācyā vā tatra ādye upapattiḥ tasyāḥ pratyaya artha tve kartṛ ādīnām arthānām lakāra antare sa avakāśānām vidhi ādayaḥ vācakāḥ syuḥ

original: evañca caitreṇa pacediti liṅdyotyā vācyā vā ? tatrādye upapattiḥ, tasyāḥ pratyayārthatve kartrādīnāmarthānāṃ lakārāntare sāvakāśānāṃ vidhyādayo vācakāḥ syuḥ |
analyzed: evam ca caitreṇa pacet iti liṅ dyotyā vācyā vā tatra ādye upapattiḥ tasyāḥ pratyaya artha tve kartṛ ādīnām arthānām lakāra antare sa avakāśānām vidhi ādayaḥ vācakāḥ syuḥ

original: evañca caitreṇa pacediti syāt, dvivacanādikam, śabādayaśca na syuḥ puruṣavyavasthā ca na syāt | dvitīye

original: tviyamupapattiḥ, virodhābhāvāt "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] ityatra sarvalakāraṅgrāhakabahuvacananirdeśācca na krartrādyarthānāmetaibadhiḥ, saṅkhyāyāḥ saṅkhyeyāpekṣitatvena teṣāṃ vācakatvāvaśyakatvāt [ca] laḍādau vartamānatvaparokṣatvādīnāṃ samāveśena "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] ityasya niravakāśatvācca |
analyzed: tu iyam upapattiḥ virodha abhāvāt laḥ karmaṇi iti atra sarva lakāraṅgrāhaka bahuvacana nirdeśāt ca na krartṛ ādi arthānām saṅkhyāyāḥ saṅkhyeya apekṣita tvena teṣām vācaka tva āvaśyaka tvāt ca laṭ ādau vartamāna tva parokṣa tva ādīnām samāveśena laḥ karmaṇi iti asya niravakāśa tvāt ca

original: na ca "māḍi luṅ" [ 3|3|175] ityādibhiḥ kālasāmānyavihiteṣu tatsāvakāśam, tatrāpi viśeṣyāsattvabhūtabhāvanāyāḥ kālākāṅkṣitatvena kālasya vācyatavāṅgīkārāt | ata eva tasya sarvalakārāpavādatvaṃ saṅgacchate |
analyzed: na ca luṅ 33175 iti ādibhiḥ kāla sāmānya vihiteṣu tat sa avakāśam tatra api viśeṣya asattva bhūta bhāvanāyāḥ kāla ākāṅkṣita tvena kālasya vācya tava aṅgīkārāt atas eva tasya sarva lakāra apavāda tvam saṅgacchate

original: na ca nimantrayeyaṃ bhavantamiti na syāt, nimantraṇāyā uktatvāditi vācyam ; prayojakaniṣṭhayornimantramayoranyayoḥ pratyārthatvasvīkārāt | tatra tatra dyotakatāpakṣo jyāyān, 'paca' ityādau pratyayaṃ vinā'pi pravartanāpratīteḥ, pacabhirhalaiḥ kṛṣatītyādau pravartanāyā dhātvarthatvasya dṛṣṭatvācca |
analyzed: na ca nimantrayeyam bhavantam iti na syāt nimantraṇāyāḥ ukta tvāt iti vācyam prayojaka niṣṭhayoḥ nimantramayoḥ anyayoḥ tatra tatra dyotaka tā pakṣaḥ jyāyān pacaḥ ityādau pratyayam vinā api pravartanā pratīteḥ pacabhiḥ halaiḥ kṛṣati ityādau pravartanāyāḥ dhātvartha tvasya dṛṣṭa tvāt ca

original: evañcātra prayojakavyāpāro'pi dhātvarthaḥ, tasyāpi pākādyanukūlatvāt | tatra phalānukūlatvāt tadupastitavyāpārāṇāṃ madhye prayojakavyāpārasya viṣayitayā viśeṣaṇanavetnānvayaḥ, itareṣāṃ tu viṣayatayā viśeṣyatvena |
analyzed: evam ca atra prayojaka vyāpāraḥ api dhātvarthaḥ tasya api pāka ādi anukūla tvāt tatra phala anukūla tvāt tad upastita vyāpārāṇām madhye prayojaka vyāpārasya viṣayitayā itareṣām tu viṣayatayā viśeṣya tvena

original: evaṃ dviprakārakānvaye liṅādayastātparyagrāhakāḥ | tathā caikāśrayikā pravartanāviṣayībūtā pākānukūlā kriyatyādiprakāreṇa pacedityādau bodhaḥ |
analyzed: evam dvi prakāraka anvaye liṅ ādayaḥ tātparya grāhakāḥ tathā ca eka āśrayikā pravartanā viṣayībūtā pāka anukūlā kriyati ādi prakāreṇa pacet ityādau bodhaḥ

original: na caivaṃ pravartanāśrayasyāpi dhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvena kartṛtvāt tatra kartari lakāraḥ syāditi vācyam, liṅādyutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ pravartanāyā apratipādanāt tadāśrayasya kartṛtvābhāvena tamādāya "laḥ karmaṇi" ityasyāpravṛtteḥ | liṅkṣu sūtradvayābhyāmeka vākyatāpannābhyāṃ vidhīyata ityadoṣa iti bahavaḥ |
analyzed: na ca evam pravartanā āśrayasya api dhātvartha vyāpāra āśraya tvena kartṛ tvāt tatra kartari lakāraḥ syāt iti vācyam liṅ ādi utpatteḥ pūrvam pravartanāyāḥ apratipādanāt tad āśrayasya kartṛ tva abhāvena tam ādāya laḥ karmaṇi iti asya apravṛtteḥ sūtra dvayābhyām eka vākya tā āpannābhyām vidhīyate iti adoṣaḥ iti bahavaḥ

original: anye tu 'pācayati' ityādau pravartanāyā viśeṣyatvasya klṛptatvenātrāpi tathaivāstu | eñcaikāśrayapākānukūlakriyāviṣayā pravarttaneti bodhaḥ | na caitasyāḥ pratyayavācyatvapakṣe 'kriyāpradhānamākhyātam' iti vacanabodhitadhātvarthaviśeṣyatāyā eva bodhanenādoṣāt |
analyzed: anye tu pācayati ityādau pravartanāyāḥ viśeṣya tvasya klṛpta tvena atra api tathā eva astu eka āśraya pāka anukūla kriyā viṣayā pravarttanā iti bodhaḥ na ca etasyāḥ pratyaya vācya tva pakṣe kriyā pradhānam ākhyātam iti vacana bodhita dhātvartha viśeṣya tāyāḥ eva bodhanena adoṣāt

original: na ca ṇicsanādau prakṛtyartha eva viśeṣya, autsargikapratyayārthaprādhānyatyāgemānābhāvāt, anubhavaviruddhatvācca 'pācayitā' ityādau ṇijarthādīnāṃ prādhānyasyāvaśkatvāccetyāhuḥ |
analyzed: na ca ṇic san ādau prakṛti arthe eva viśeṣya autsargika pratyayārtha prādhānya tyāga imāna abhāvāt anubhava viruddha tvāt ca pācayitā ityādau ṇij artha ādīnām prādhānyasya avaśka tvāt ca iti āhuḥ

original: tatra kārakaviśiṣṭadhātvarthasya pravartanāyām, tādṛśadhātvarthe,pravartanāyā vānvayaḥ, kārakānvayaṃ vinā dhātvarthasya nirūpayitumaśakyatvāt |
analyzed: tatra kāraka viśiṣṭa dhātvarthasya pravartanāyām tādṛśa dhātvarthe pravartanāyāḥ vā anvayaḥ kāraka anvayam vinā dhātvarthasya nirūpayitum aśakya tvāt

original: evañca pravartanākṣiptamajñāpyatvaṃ śreyaḥ sādhanatvaca viśiṣṭa eva, kārakaviśiṣṭakriyāyā eva pravartanāviṣayatvāt | dhātvarthasya prāptatve tu tātparyato guṇāṃśe paryavasyata | yathā 'daghnā juhoti' iti | lihādau pravartanā ca vastuto vartamānakālaeva bhāsate, śabdaśaktisvabhāvād, vartamānakālasyāntaraṅgatvācca |
analyzed: evam ca pravartanā ākṣiptam ajñāpyatvam śreyaḥ sādhanatvam ca viśiṣṭe eva kāraka viśiṣṭa kriyāyāḥ eva pravartanā viṣayatvāt dhātvarthasya prāptatve tu tātparyataḥ guṇa aṃśe yathā daghnā juhoti iti liha ādau pravartanā ca vastutas vartamāna kālaḥ eva bhāsate śabda śakti svabhāvāt vartamāna kālasya antaraṅga tvāt ca

original: dhātvarthastu bhaviṣyatkāla eva, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt |
analyzed: dhātvarthaḥ tu bhaviṣyat kālaḥ eva śabda śakti svabhāvāt

original: etena preraṇā prayojyapākavartamānatādaśāyāṃ 'pacet' iti prayogāpattiriti nirastam | vidhiliṅyuttamastu na, svapravṛttau svecchāyāḥ svarūpasatyā eva kāramatvena tajjñānānupayogāt | idamevābhipretya 'uttamapuruṣo vidhiśaktipratibandhakaḥ' iti mīmāṃsakāḥ |
analyzed: etena preraṇā prayojya pāka vartamāna tā daśāyām pacet iti prayoga āpattiḥ iti nirastam vidhi liṅi uttamaḥ tu na sva pravṛttau sva icchāyāḥ svarūpa satyāḥ eva tad jñāna anupayogāt idam eva abhipretya uttama puruṣaḥ vidhi śakti pratibandhakaḥ iti mīmāṃsakāḥ

original: 'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet' ityādau nañsamabhivyāhāre tu nivṛtirliṅartha iti sarveṣṭasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: na kalañjam bhakṣayet ityādau nañ samabhivyāhāre tu nivṛtiḥ liṅ arthaḥ iti sarva iṣṭa siddhiḥ

original: iti tiṅarthavicāraḥ
analyzed: iti tiṅ artha vicāraḥ

original: atha sanādyarthavicāraḥ
analyzed: atha san ādi artha vicāraḥ

original: atha dhātuprakṛtikasanādyartho nirūpyate
analyzed: atha dhātu prakṛti kasana ādi arthaḥ nirūpyate

original: 'pipaṭhiṣati' ityādau sanarthaḥ = icchā | tatra dhātvarthasya karmatvasamānakarttṛ katvaitadubhayasambandhenānvayo vyatpattivaicitryāt, "dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā" [ 3|1|7 ] iti sūtrasvarasācca | punaḥ punaratiśayena vā pacati 'pāpacyate' ityādau yaṅā tu prakṛtyarthagataṃ paunaḥ punyaṃ bāhulyaṃ vā bodhyate |
analyzed: pipaṭhiṣati ityādau san arthaḥ icchā tatra dhātvarthasya karmatva samāna karttṛ ka tva etad ubhaya sambandhena anvayaḥ vyatpatti vaicitryāt dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samāna kartṛkāt icchāyām vā iti sūtra svarasāt ca punar punar atiśayena vā pacati pāpacyate ityādau yaṅā tu prakṛti artha gatam paunaḥpunyam bāhulyam vā bodhyate

original: kvacit kauṭilayagarhādyapi "nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau" [ 3|1|23], "lupasadacara" [ 3|1|24 ] ityāditattacchāstraprāmāṇyāt |'śvā mumūrṣati' ityādau āśaṅkā sanarthaḥ, śvakartṛkamāśaṅkāviṣayo maraṇamati bodhaḥ | evameva 'kūlaṃ pipatiṣati' ityatrāpi |
analyzed: kvacid kauṭilaya garha ādi api nityam kauṭilye gatau ityādi tad tad śāstra prāmāṇyāt śvā mumūrṣati ityādau āśaṅkā sa narthaḥ śva kartṛkam āśaṅkā viṣayaḥ maraṇam ati bodhaḥ evam eva kūlam pipatiṣati iti atra api

original: icchāropeṇa pratyaya iti mate pūrvoktārthaḥ paścanmānasabodhaviṣayaḥ | tatra cedṛśasamabhivyāhāra eva kāraṇam | 'pācayati' ityādau ṇijarthaḥ preraṇetyādyūhyam |
analyzed: icchā āropeṇa pratyayaḥ iti mate pūrvokta arthaḥ paścat mānasa bodha viṣayaḥ tatra ca īdṛśa samabhivyāhāraḥ eva kāraṇam pācayati ityādau ṇij arthaḥ preraṇā ityādi ūhyam

original: iti sanādyarthavicāraḥ |
analyzed: iti san ādi artha vicāraḥ

original: atha kṛdarthavicāraḥ
analyzed: atha kṛt artha vicāraḥ

original: atha dhātuprakṛtikakṛdartho vicāryate
analyzed: atha dhātu prakṛtika kṛt arthaḥ vicāryate

original: tatra kartṛkarmavihitakṛtāmāśrayo'rthaḥ | tatra karttari vyāpāraśrayaḥ, karmaṇi phalāśrayaḥ, karmakṛtsamabhivyāhāre ca phalavyāpārayorvyatyāsaḥ | evañca 'gato grāmaḥ' ityādau vyāpārajanyottaradeśasaṃyogāśrayo grāma iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: tatra kartṛ karma vihita kṛtām āśrayaḥ ṛthaḥ tatra karttari vyāpāra śrayaḥ karmaṇi phala āśrayaḥ karma kṛt samabhivyāhāre ca phala vyāpārayoḥ vyatyāsaḥ evañca gataḥ grāmaḥ ityādau vyāpāra janya uttara deśa saṃyoga āśrayaḥ grāmaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: na ca tiṅante kartṛkarmaṇordhātvarthaviśeṣaṇatāyā dṛṣṭatvenātrāpi tathaivocitamiti vācyam, tiṅanta eva 'bhāvapradhānam' ityasya pravṛtteḥ, 'sattvapradhānāni' ityuttaraniruktena tayostatra viśeṣyatāya bodhanācca | nāmni sattvaprādhānyaṃ casvaghaṭaprakṛtibhūtadhātvarthāpekṣayaiva | tena vibhaktyarthasyāsattvabhūtasya prādhānyeṣapi na kṣatiḥ |
analyzed: na ca tiṅ ante kartṛ karmaṇoḥ dhātvartha viśeṣaṇatāyāḥ dṛṣṭa tvena atra api tathā eva ucitam iti vācyam tiṅ ante eva bhāva pradhānam iti asya pravṛtteḥ sattva pradhānāni iti uttara niruktena tayoḥ tatra viśeṣyatāya bodhanāt ca nāmni sattva prādhānyam ca sva ghaṭa prakṛti bhūta dhātvartha apekṣayā eva tena vibhakti arthasya a sattva bhūtasya na kṣatiḥ

original: nāmapadena cātra sattvavācakapratyayāntaṃ gṛhyate, ata eva 'pacati kalpam' ityādau na doṣaḥ | bhāvakṛtsu kṛtyasañjñakatavyādīnāṃ ktakhalarthānāñca sādhyāvasthāpannadhātvarthānuvādakatvameva | ata eva 'edhitavyam' ityādau na kriyāntarākāṅkṣādi | atasteṣvekavacanameva | 'sattvapradhānāni nāmāni' ityukteḥ sādhyāvasthasyāpi liṅgayogaḥ |
analyzed: nāma padena ca atra sattva vācaka pratyaya antam gṛhyate atas eva pacati kalpam ityādau na doṣaḥ bhāva kṛtsu kṛtya sañjñaka tavya ādīnām kta khalarthānām ca sādhya avasthā āpanna dhātvartha anuvādaka tvam eva atas eva edhitavyam ityādau na kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā ādi atas teṣu ekavacanam eva sattva pradhānāni nāmāni iti ukteḥ sādhya avasthasya api liṅga yogaḥ

original: liṅgayogānvayitvameva ca sattvam | tatra liṅgāntarāsambhavāt liṅgasarvanāmatvācca napuṃsakatvameva | ata eva "tayoreva kṛtyakta" [ 3|4|70 ] iti sūtre "laḥ karmaṇi" [ 3|4|69 ] iti sūtragṛhītabhāvakarmaṇoreva tayorityanena parāmarśaḥ saṅgacchata ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: liṅga yoga anvayi tvam eva ca sattvam tatra liṅga antara asambhavāt liṅga sarvanāma tvāt ca napuṃsaka tvam eva atas eva tayoḥ eva iti sūtre laḥ karmaṇi 3469 iti sūtra gṛhīta bhāva karmaṇoḥ eva tayoḥ iti anena parāmarśaḥ saṅgacchate iti āhuḥ

original: ghañādivācyabhāvastu siddhāvasthāpannaḥ, 'pākaḥ' ityādau kriyāntarākāṅkṣādīnāṃ darśanāt | na caivam 'odanasya pākaḥ' ityādau kārakānvayo na syāt, sādhyāvasthāpannakriyāyāsveva tadanvayavyutpatteḥ ; 'kārake' ityadhikārāt ; 'kārakam' iti mahāsañjñākaraṇād veti vācyam, prakṛtyā sādhyāvasthāpannasyaivopasthāpanāt |
analyzed: ghañ ādi vācya bhāvaḥ tu siddha avasthā āpannaḥ pākaḥ ityādau kriyāntara ākāṅkṣā ādīnām darśanāt na ca evam odanasya pākaḥ ityādau kāraka anvayaḥ na syāt sādhya avasthā āpanna kriyāyāsu eva tad anvaya vyutpatteḥ kārake iti adhikārāt kārakam iti mahā sañjñā karaṇāt vā iti vācyam prakṛtyā sādhya avasthā āpannasya eva upasthāpanāt

original: na cādhyāhṛtatiṅantārthakriyāyāmeva 'odanasya pākaḥ' ityādau kārakānvayo'stviti vācyam, "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ" [ 2|3|65 ] iti kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhyanāpatteḥ, asāmarthyāt 'odanapākaḥ' iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsānāpatteśca | na ca śeṣaṣṭhyaiva samāsaḥ, samāsasya vaikalpikatvācca vākyamapi siddhamiti vācyam, karmatvādiprakārakabodhānubhavānāpatteḥ |
analyzed: na ca adhyāhṛta tiṅanta artha kriyāyām eva odanasya pākaḥ ityādau kāraka anvayoḥ tu iti vācyam kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti kṛt yoga ṣaṣṭhī anāpatteḥ asāmarthyāt odana pākaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī samāsa anāpatteḥ ca na ca śeṣa ṣṭhyā eva samāsaḥ samāsasya vaikalpika tvāt ca vākyam api siddham iti vācyam karma tva ādi prakāraka bodha anubhava anāpatteḥ

original: kiñcaivam 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ' ityarthasya vyarthatvāpattiḥ | na caivam, 'kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ' ityapi syāditi cet, iṣṭāpatteḥ |
analyzed: kiñca evam kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti arthasya vyartha tva āpattiḥ na ca evam kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ iti api syāt iti ced iṣṭa āpatteḥ

original: na caivam 'pākaḥ' ityādau vāradvayaṃ kriyābodhaḥ syāditi vācyam, ekasyaiva padārthasya sādhyatvasiddhatvābhyāmupasthitirityatra tātparyāt | na ca viruddhābhyāmābhyāṃ kathamekapadopasthitiḥ, bhāṣyādiprāmāṇyena bodhakabhedena caikādhikaraṇavṛttitvenopasthitisvīkārāt | tayorvirodhasyaivābhāva ityanye |
analyzed: na ca evam pākaḥ ityādau vāra dvayam kriyā bodhaḥ syāt iti vācyam ekasya eva padārthasya sādhyatva siddhatvābhyām upasthitiḥ iti atra tātparyāt na ca viruddhābhyām ābhyām katham eka pada upasthitiḥ bhāṣya ādi prāmāṇyena bodhaka bhedena ca eka adhikaraṇa vṛtti tvena upasthiti svīkārāt tayoḥ virodhasya eva abhāvaḥ iti anye

original: tatra dhātvarthaphalānvaye "śobhanaṃ pākaḥ" ityeva | pākādipadebhyo'pi phalasyaiva sādhyatvatenaivopasthāpanāt "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ" [ 2|3|65 ] iti ṣaṣṭhī tu na, kartṛsāhacaryeṇa karmaṇo'dhātvarthasyaiva tatra grahaṇāt | spaṣṭañcedam "pūjanāt pūjitam" [ 8|1|67 ] ityatrāṣṭame bhāṣye |

original: 'vrajamavaruṇaddhi gāma' [atra] uttarakālikadeśāntaragatipratibandhānukūlānuyogitāsambandhāvacchinottaradeśasaṃyogānukūlo vyāpāro rudherarthaḥ | anuyogitāsambandhāvacchinnaḥ sa vrajaniṣṭhaḥ | gauḥ pradhānam, uddeśyatvāt | pratiyogitāsambandhāvacchinnottaradeśasaṃyogārthatve karmadvārā kriyāśrayatvavivakṣāyāmadhikaraṇatvam |

original: 'śataṃ jayati devadattam' -- dānānukūlaḥ parābhavākhyo vyāpāro jayaterarthaḥ | svatvotpattyanukūlavyāpāramātrārthakatve'pādānatvaṃ sampradānatvaṃ vā |

original: 'devadattaṃ śataṃ muṣṇāti' -- parājñānatad‌dravyāgahaṇobhayānukūlo vyāpāro muṣerarthaḥ | yadā tu grahaṇānukūvyāpāra evārthaḥ, tadā devadattasyāpādānatvām |

original: 'ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati, harati, karṣati, vahati vā' -- uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpāranukūlo vyāpāro nayaterarthaḥ | sa eva skandhagrahaṇādipūrvo vaheḥ, gatyanukūlo vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ kṛṣeḥ, balād‌grahaṇapūrvakaṃ deśāntaraprāpaṇaṃ harateḥ | ajānayanasyod‌deśyatvād ajā pradhānam | gamanamātrāthakatve grāmasyādhikaraṇatvaṃ bodhyam |
analyzed: ajām grāmam nayati harati karṣati vahati vā uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ nayateḥ arthaḥ saḥ eva skandha grahaṇa ādi pūrvaḥ vaheḥ gati anukūlaḥ vyāpāra viśeṣaḥ kṛṣeḥ balāt grahaṇa pūrvakam deśa antara prāpaṇam harateḥ ajā nayanasya uddeśya tvāt ajā pradhānam gamana mātra āthaka tve grāmasya adhikaraṇa tvam bodhyam

original: yadā tu grāmīyā'jāsaṃyoga evod‌deśyaḥ, tadā grāma eva pradhānam | etena 'tapte payasi dadhyānayati, sā vaiśvadevyāmikṣā' ityatra tacchabdena prādhānyāt payasaḥ parāmarśa iti mīmāṃsakagranthā vyākhyātāḥ | payaḥ sthāne

original: dadhyāgamanenārthaprādhānyamādāya vā teṣāmupapattiḥ ata eva saptamyupādānaṃ sārthakamiti dik |

original: aparañca 'akarmakadhātubhiryoge deśaḥ kālo bhāvo gantavyo'dhvā ca karmasañjñaka iti vācyam' iti | deśaḥ kurupañcālādiḥ, akarmakaśabdena deśakālādibhinnakaramarahitā avivakṣitakarmāṇaśca | tena 'māsaṃ pacati' ityapi gantavyo'dhvā krośādiḥ, bhāvo bhāvādyarthavihikaghañajādyantaḥ |

original: 'kurūn svapiti, māsamāste, krośaṃ śete, godohamāste |' śeṣatvavivakṣāyāmetatpravṛtterdvitīyārthaḥ sambandhaḥ | adhikaraṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ saptamyeva | etaddhātvarthasambanditvena vivakṣitādhāratvañcaitatkarmatvalakṣaṇaṃ bodhyam |

original: "gatibuddhipratayavasānārthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa ṇau" [ 1|4|52 ] iti sūtrabodhitakarmatvaṃ tu ṇijarthavyāpārajanyatattaddhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvam | tattaddhātubhedena karmatvalakṣaṇānāṃ bhinnatvānna lakṣaṇātivyāptyādikam | ṇyantahṛkṛghaṭitakarmatvalakṣaṇe tṛtīyāntapadānabhidheyatve satīti viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam |

original: 'tena devadattena hārayati kaṭam' ityādau nātivyāptiḥ, ṇyantābhivādidṛśostu tattve sati ātmanepadapratyayāntataddhātūpāttaphalāśrayatvaṃ karmatvam | vaikuṇṭhamadhiśete,adhitiṣṭhati, adhyāste, upavasati, anuvasati, adhivasati, āvasati, vetyādāvādhāro dvitīyārthaḥ |

original: etad dhātuyoge'dhikaraṇatvameva karmatvam, 'ādhāra' ityanuvarttamāne "adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma" [ 1|4|46], "upānvadhyāṅvasaḥ" [ 1|4|48 ], iti sūtrasvarasāt | upavasateścābhuktyarthakātiriktopavatyādhāratvaṃ bodhyam | tena 'vane upavasati' ityādau nātivyāptiḥ | abhiniviśatikarmatvañca saptamyantapadānabhidheyatad‌dhātvarthadhāratvaṃ bodhyam |
analyzed: etat dhātu yoga idhikaraṇa tvam eva karma tvam ādhāraḥ iti anuvarttamāne adhi śīṅ sthā āsām karma 1446 upa anu adhi āṅ vasaḥ iti sūtra svarasāt upavasateḥ ca abhukti arthaka atirikta upavati ādhāra tvam bodhyam tena vane upavasati ityādau na ativyāptiḥ abhiniviśati karma tvam ca saptamī anta pada anabhidheya tad dhātvartha dhāra tvam bodhyam

original: 'krūramabhikrudhyati, abhiduhyati' ityādau viṣayatāsambandhitvaṃ bodhyam |

original: hāśabdayogābhāvāt | 'bubhukṣitaṃ na pratibhāti' ityādau bubhukṣitasambandhikiñcidviṣayapratibhānābhāva ityarthaḥ | pratibhā bhaṭiti sphūrttiḥ |

original: 'antarā tvāṃ māṃ ca hariḥ' ityatrāntarāśabdo madhyārthakaḥ, avadhitvarūpaḥ, sambandho dvitīyārthaḥ | evañca tvanmadavadhikamadhyavṛttirhaririti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: antarā tvām mām ca hariḥ iti atra antarā śabdaḥ madhya arthakaḥ avadhi tva rūpaḥ sambandhaḥ dvitīya arthaḥ evam ca tvad mad avadhika madhya vṛttiḥ hariḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: 'antarā hariṃ na sukham' ityatrātyantābhāvavānantarāśabdārthaḥ dvitīyārthaḥ pratiyogitvamabhāve'nveti | hariśabdaśca tad‌bhakyādilākṣaṇikaḥ | evañca haribhaktikābhāvavad‌vṛttisukhapratiyogiko'bhāva iti bodhaḥ | evamantareṇaśabdo'pyubhayārthaḥ | pratiyogiyogitadyoge'pi dvitīyā |
analyzed: antarā harim na sukham iti atra atyanta abhāvavān antarā śabda arthaḥ dvitīyā arthaḥ pratiyogitvam abhāvena iti hari śabdaḥ ca tad bhakya ādi lākṣaṇikaḥ evam ca hari bhaktika abhāvavat vṛtti sukha pratiyogikaḥ bhāvaḥ iti bodhaḥ evam antareṇa śabdaḥ api ubhaya arthaḥ pratiyogi yogi tad yoge pi dvitīyā

original: 'japamanuprāvarṣat' ityatra dvitīyārtho lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvaḥ sambandho hetuśca | anuśca sambandhaviśeṣadyotakaḥ | lakṣyatavañca jñānajanyajñānaviṣayatvam | japajñānena hi japakālajñānadvārā kālaviśeṣaviśiṣṭā vṛttirjñāpyate | ata eva 'kadā vṛṣṭo devaḥ' iti paśne idamuttaram | tatra prakṛtyartho hetāvabhedenānveti |
analyzed: japam anuprāvarṣat iti atra dvitīyā arthaḥ lakṣya lakṣaṇa bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ hetuḥ ca anuḥ ca sambandha viśeṣa dyotakaḥ lakṣyatavam ca jñāna janya jñāna viṣaya tvam japa jñānena hi japa kāla jñāna dvārā kāla viśeṣa viśiṣṭā vṛttiḥ jñāpyate atas eva kadā vṛṣṭaḥ devaḥ iti paśne idam uttaram tatra prakṛti arthaḥ hetau abhedena anveti

original: sa ca lakṣyatvaikadeśajñāne, ekapadārthayorapyevakāradau parasparānvayadarśanāt, japābhinnahetujñānajanyajñānaviṣayo varṣaṇamiti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: sa ca lakṣya tva eka deśa jñāne eka padārthayoḥ api eva kāra dau paraspara anvaya darśanāt japa abhinna hetu jñāna janya jñāna viṣayaḥ varṣaṇam iti bodhaḥ

original: 'nadīmanvavasitā senā' -- dvitīyārthaḥ sāhityamanudyotyam | nadyā saha sambaddheti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: nadīm anvavasitā senā dvitīyā arthaḥ sāhityam anudyotyam nadyā saha sambaddhā iti bodhaḥ

original: 'anuhariṃ surāḥ' -- apakarṣarūpahīnatvasambandho'nudyotyo dvitīyārthaḥ, haripratiyogikāpakarṣavanta iti bodhaḥ | uparimityatrāpvevam |

original: 'vṛkṣaṃ prati, paryanu vā vidyotate vidyut' lakṣyatvasarvabodho dvitīyārthaḥ pratyādidyotyaḥ | vṛkṣaprakāśena vidyujjñānāt tasya lakṣaṇatvam | tena hi digviśeṣāvacchinnā vidyud jñāpyate | vṛkṣajñānajanyajñānaviṣayo vidyud‌vidyota iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: vṛkṣam prati paryanu vā vidyotate vidyut lakṣya tva sarva bodhaḥ dvitīya arthaḥ pratyādi dyotyaḥ vṛkṣa prakāśena vidyut jñānāt tasya lakṣaṇa tvam tena hi diś viśeṣa avacchinnā vidyut jñāpyate vṛkṣa jñāna janya jñāna viṣayaḥ vidyut vidyotaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: bhakto viṣṇuṃ prati --- viṣayatvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | tasya caikadeśabhaktāvanvayaḥ |viṣṇuviṣayakabhaktyāśraya iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: bhaktaḥ viṣṇum prati viṣayatvam dvitīyā arthaḥ tasya ca eka deśa bhaktau anvayaḥ viṣṇu viṣayaka bhakti āśrayaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: lakṣmīrhariṃ prati -- svatvamaryarthaḥ | haripratiyogikasvatvavīti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: lakṣmīḥ harim prati svatvam ari arthaḥ bodhaḥ

original: 'vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati -- siñcati ' atra vīpsā dirvicanadyatyā | vīpsāpadena bodhayitumicchāviṣayavyāpyatvaṃ buddisthāyāvatprakṛtyarthaniṣṭhamucyate | vyāpyatvaviśiṣṭavṛkṣādīnāñca svavṛttivyāptinirūpakatvena secanādyanavaya ityatra pratyādayastātparyagrāhakāḥ, karmapravacanīyatayā sambandhāvacchedakatvasya yuktatvāt |
analyzed: vṛkṣam vṛkṣam prati siñcati atra vīpsā vīpsā padena bodhayitum icchā viṣaya vyāpyatvam buddi sthāyā vat prakṛti artha niṣṭham ucyate vyāpyatva viśiṣṭa vṛkṣa ādīnām ca sva vṛtti vyāpti nirūpaka tvena secana ādi anavayaḥ iti atra prati ādayaḥ tātparya grāhakāḥ karmapravacanīya tayā sambandha avacchedaka tvasya yuktatvāt

original: yadyapi 'vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ siñcati' ityādau pratiṃ vināpi mānāntaragṛhītatātparyavaśāt tenaiva sambandhenānvayaḥ, tathāpi tatsattve so'pi tannirṇāyaka ityetāvataiva sambandhāvacchedakatvam | tatra vṛkṣādīnāṃ secanakarmatve'pi prathamataḥ pratidyotyasamabandhenāntaraṅgatvāt tannimittopapadavibhaktibhūtadvitīyaiva |
analyzed: yadi api vṛkṣam vṛkṣam siñcati ityādau pratim vinā api māna antara gṛhīta tātparya vaśāt tena eva sambandhena anvayaḥ tathā api tad sattve saḥ api tad nirṇāyakaḥ iti etāvatā eva sambandha avacchedaka tvam tatra vṛkṣa ādīnām secana karma tve pi prathamatas pratidyotya samabandhena antaraṅga tvāt tad nimitta upapada vibhakti bhūta dvitīyā eva

original: ata eva pratyarthaṃ śabdaniveśa ityādāvarthasya niveśanakriyānirūpitādhikaraṇatve'pi arthamarthaṃ prati ityeva vigraho bhāṣyādau darśitaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva prati artham śabda niveśaḥ ityādau arthasya niveśana kriyā nirūpita adhikaraṇa tve pi artham artham prati iti eva vigrahaḥ bhāṣya ādau darśitaḥ

original: etena "upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī" iti nyāyāt karmaṇyevātra dvitīyetyapāstam, yugapadubhayānvayasya buddhyā rūḍhatva eva tatpravṛtteḥ | pratidyotyasambandhenānvaye'pi āśrayatvenānanvayācca | vṛttiviṣaye
analyzed: etena upapada vibhakteḥ kāraka vibhaktiḥ balīyasī iti nyāyāt karmaṇi eva atra dvitīyā iti apāstam yugapad ubhaya anvayasya buddhyāḥ rūḍha tve eva tad pravṛtteḥ pratidyotya sambandhena anvaye api āśraya tvena ananvayāt ca vṛtti viṣaye

original: tu pratireva vīpsāyā api dyotakaḥ |
analyzed: tu pratiḥ eva vīpsāyāḥ api dyotakaḥ

original: kiñca, karmaṇi dvitīyāyāṃ pratinā sāmarthyābhāvāt prativṛkṣaṃ siñcatīti prayogānāpattiḥ |
analyzed: kiñca karmaṇi dvitīyāyām pratinā sāmarthya abhāvāt prati vṛkṣam siñcati iti prayoga anāpattiḥ

original: etenātra karmaṇyeva dvitīyā, paryādayastu kriyāviśeṣakā eveti haradattādyuktamapāstam, kriyāviśeṣakatve'nvarthatayā karmapravacanīyasañjñāyā evānāpatteḥ | "avyayaṃviṅakti" [ 2|1|6 ] itisūtre haradattena sambandhaparicchedakatvasyaivoktatvācca |
analyzed: etena atra karmaṇi eva dvitīyā pari ādayaḥ tu kriyā viśeṣakāḥ eva iti haradatta ādi uktam apāstam kriyā viśeṣaka tva invarthatayā karmapravacanīya sañjñāyāḥ eva anāpatteḥ avyayam viṅakti iti sūtre haradattena sambandha paricchedaka tvasya eva ukta tvāt ca

original: ata eva bhāṣye'pi 'kimarthaṃ punaridamucayate , na copasargādisañjñābādhanārtham, kriyāyogābhāvāt' ityuktvā 'dvitīyārtham' iti siddhāntitam |
analyzed: atas eva bhāṣye pi kimartham punar idam ucayate na ca upasarga ādi sañjñā bādhana artham kriyā yoga abhāvāt iti uktvā dvitīya artham iti siddhāntitam

original: vṛkṣaṃ prati siñcatītyudāraṇe kvacit kriyānvaye karmatvādeva dvitīyā siddheti praśnaḥ | pratyādyavacchedyasambandhānvayenāntaraṅgātvāt prāptaṣaṣṭhībādhanārthamakarmakārthañcāvaśyakamityuttaramiti mama pratibhāti |
analyzed: vṛkṣam prati siñcati iti udāraṇe kvacid kriyā anvaye karma tvāt eva dvitīyā siddhā iti praśnaḥ prati ādi avacchedya sambandha anvayena antaraṅga a tvāt prāpta ṣaṣṭhī bādhana artham akarmaka artham ca āvaśyakam iti uttaram iti mama pratibhāti

original: 'yadatra mamābhiṣyāt, taddīyatām' atra yacchabdo buddhisthatvena bhāgavācī, matsambandhiyadbhāgakartṛkā etadadhikarayaṇikā sattā preraṇāviṣayaḥ, tatkarmakaṃ dānamiti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: yat atra mama abhiṣyāt tat dīyatām atra yad śabdaḥ buddhi sthatvena bhāga vācī mad sambandhi yad bhāga kartṛkā etad adhikarayaṇikā sattā preraṇā viṣayaḥ tad karmakam dānam iti bodhaḥ

original: 'sarpiṣo'pi sayāt' atrāpi bindurapapadārthadyotakaḥ | syāditi ttiṅāṃ kartṛsāmānyavācakena bindutvena tadviśeṣo lakṣyata iti tattvam | sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ, dyotyabindau sarpiṣa ityavayavāvayavibhāvenānveti | binduśca kriyāyāmādheyatayā daurlabhyasambandena cānveti | atrāpyapireva tātparyagrāhakaḥ |
analyzed: atra api binduḥ apapadārtha dyotakaḥ syāt iti kartṛ sāmānya vācakena bindu tvena tad viśeṣaḥ lakṣyate iti tattvam sambhāvanāyām liṅ dyotya bindau sarpiṣaḥ iti avayava avayavi bhāvena anveti binduḥ ca kriyāyām ādheyatayā daurlabhya sambandena ca anveti atra api apiḥ eva tātparya grāhakaḥ

original: evañca sarpiravayavabindudaurlabhyaprayuktadaurlabhyavatī tadabhinnaikakartṛkā sambhāvanāviṣayaḥ satteti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca sarpiḥ avayava bindu daurlabhya prayukta daurlabhyavatī tad abhinna eka kartṛkā sambhāvanā viṣayaḥ sattā iti bodhaḥ

original: 'api stuyād viṣṇum' sambhāvane liṅ | apirlirṅthasambhāvanāviṣayatayā śakyatvasya dyotakaḥ | viṣṇukarmakaitatkartṛkāśakyatvena sambhāvyamānā stutiriti bodhaḥ | viṣṇuviṣayāyāḥ1[fn 'stuteḥ' śeṣaḥ | ] śakyatvasambhāvane vānyaviṣayāniścayena śakyeti phalati |
analyzed: api stuyāt viṣṇum sambhāvane liṅ apiḥ liṅ tha sambhāvanā viṣayatayā śakyatvasya dyotakaḥ viṣṇu karmaka etad kartṛka aśakyatvena sambhāvyamānā stutiḥ iti bodhaḥ viṣṇu viṣaya stuti śeṣa śakyatva sambhāvanā vā anya viṣaya aniścaya śakyā iti phalati

original: etena 'api vedāntapāragam' ityādāvapiyoge svārthe na tātparyamiti dharmaśāstragranthā vyākhyātāḥ | īdṛśeṣu sambhāvanāviṣayatayaucityaṃ dyotyam, sambhāvitaucityasya cānuṣṭhānamayuktamiti svārthe tātparyābhāvo bodhyaḥ |
analyzed: etena api vedāntapāragam ityādau api yoge svārthe na tātparyam iti dharma śāstra granthāḥ vyākhyātāḥ īdṛśeṣu sambhāvanā viṣaya tayā aucityam dyotyam sambhāvita aucityasya ca anuṣṭhānam ayuktam iti svārthe tātparya abhāvaḥ bodhyaḥ

original: yadvā, śakyatvādinā sambhāvanaṃ kriyāviṣayamapi dyotyam,liṅ tu vidhyādau | evañca sambhāvane'pi "karmapravacanīye" ityanuśāsanaṃ yathāśrutameva | ādye tu sambhāvanāviṣaye varttamānaḥ 'apiḥ' iti tadartho bodhyaḥ |
analyzed: yat vā śakya tva ādinā sambhāvanam kriyā viṣayam api dyotyam liṅ tu vidhi ādau evam ca sambhāvane pi karmapravacanīye iti anuśāsanam yathāśrutam eva ādye tu sambhāvanā viṣaye varttamānaḥ apiḥ iti tad arthaḥ bodhyaḥ

original: 'api stuhi' -- stutāvicchāpravṛttiviṣayatāpi dyotyā | icchāpravṛttiviṣayā stutiriti bodhaḥ | 'api stuyād vṛṣalam' kriyāgataṃ garhyatvamapidyotyam | vṛṣalakarmikā garhyā stutiriti bodhaḥ | stutergarhyatve tatkartturapi garhyatvaṃ phalati | tadeva dhigdevadattamityādinānūdyate |
analyzed: api stuhi stutau icchā pravṛtti viṣaya tā api dyotyā icchā pravṛtti viṣayā stutiḥ iti bodhaḥ api stuyāt vṛṣalam kriyā gatam garhya tvam apidyotyam vṛṣala karmikā garhyā stutiḥ iti bodhaḥ stuteḥ garhya tve tad karttuḥ api garhya tvam phalati tat eva dhik devadattam ityādinā anūdyate

original: 'māsamadhīte' atra triṃśaddinasamudāyo māsapadārthaḥ, tattatasambandhaśca dinaparyāptatriṃśatvavyāpakatvam | tatra triṃśattvādermāsādipadādeva lābhād vyāpakatāmātraṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | atastraṃśatsu dineṣu kiñcitkālāvacchedenādhyayanasambandhe'pi tatprayogopapattiḥ |
analyzed: māsam adhīte atra triṃśat dina samudāyaḥ māsa padārthaḥ tad tata sambandhaḥ ca dina paryāpta triṃśatva vyāpaka tvam tatra triṃśat tva ādeḥ māsa ādi padāt eva lābhāt vyāpaka tā mātram dvitīyā arthaḥ atas traṃśatsu dineṣu kiñcid kāla avacchedena adhyayana sambandhe pi tad prayoga upapattiḥ

original: vyāpākatñca triṃśattvavanniṣṭhapratiyogivyadhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakāvacchinnatvam, taccadhyayanādāvanveti |
analyzed: triṃśat tva vat niṣṭha pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogitā anavacchedaka avacchinna tvam tat ca adhyayana ādau anveti

original: pratiyogivyadhikaraṇetiviśeṣaṇādināvāntaradaṇḍādāvadhyayanābhāva'pyuktaprayogīpapattiḥ | māsapadañca triṃśaddinaparameva, na tu tāvatkālasthāyyakhaṇḍavastuparam, ekadinādhyayane'pi tādṛśākhaṇḍakāle pratiyogivyadhikaraṇadhyayanābhāvena māsamadhīta iti prayogāpatteḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa iti viśeṣaṇa ādinā avāntara daṇḍa ādau adhyayana abhau api ukta prayogi upapattiḥ māsa padam ca triṃśat dina param eva na tu tāvat kāla sthāyi akhaṇḍa vastu param eka dina adhyayane api tādṛśa ākhaṇḍa kāle pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa dhyayana abhāvena māsam adhīte iti prayoga āpatteḥ

original: māsaghaṭakaṃ dinañca sūryodayāvadhi sūryodayāntakaparyantasthāyyakhaṇḍavastuparam, na tu kriyāsamūhaḥ | tathā satyekaikakriyādivyakterapi māsatvādhikaraṇatayā tatra pratiyogivyadhikaraṇādhyayanādyabhāvasattvena bādhāpatteḥ | 'dinaṃ svapiti' ityādau dinapadaṃ triṃśaddaṇḍakūṭaparam | sūryodayāvadhi sūryāstaparyantakṣaṇakūṭaparaṃ vā |
analyzed: māsa ghaṭakam dinam ca sūrya udaya avadhi sūrya udaya antaka paryanta sthāyi akhaṇḍa vastu param na tu kriyā samūhaḥ tathā sati ekaika kriyā ādi vyakteḥ api māsa tva adhikaraṇa tayā tatra pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa adhyayana ādi abhāva sattvena bādhā āpatteḥ dinam svapiti ityādau dina padam triṃśat daṇḍa kūṭa param sūrya udaya avadhi sūrya asta paryanta kṣaṇa kūṭa param vā

original: ato naikadaṇḍādisvapne tathā prayogaḥ | triṃśattvādikaṃ ca tātparyavaśādviśiṣya tatra triṃśattvameva bhāsate | etenaikamāsavyāpakādhyayanasthale'pi māsāntare'dhyayanābhāvasattavena māsavyāpakatāyā adhyayane bādhena māsamadhīta ityādyupapattiriti parāstam |
analyzed: atas na eka daṇḍa ādi svapne tathā prayogaḥ triṃśat tva ādikam ca tātparya vaśāt viśiṣya tatra triṃśat tvam eva bhāsate etena eka māsa vyāpaka adhyayana sthale api māsa antara idhyayana abhāva sattavena māsa vyāpaka tāyāḥ adhyayane bādhena māsam adhīte ityādi upapattiḥ iti parāstam

original: evam 'krośaṃ kuṭilā nadī' ityādāvapi yat kiñcit krośatvavanniṣṭhapratiyogivyadhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakāvaccinnatvaṃ kuṭilādau bhāsate |

original: ayamapyakarmakaḥ, dhātvarthopasaṃgṛhītakarmakatvāt | etadd‌vayayoge sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | harisambandhī krodhaḥ, tatsambandhyapakāreccheti ca bodhaḥ | viṣayatayā svārthakomasambandhitvameva caitadyoge sampradānatvam | utkarṣagocaro dveṣa īrṣyā | śaucācārādiguṇaviṣaye dambhādikṛtatvadoṣādhyāso'sūyā | etadyoge karma caturthyarthaḥ |

original: atra svaniṣṭhajanyatānirūpakatvenaivānvayaḥ | muktijanakaṃ haribhajanamiti bodhaḥ | adhyayananirūpitopakārakatāvān vāsa iti bodhaḥ |

original: 'bhaktirjñānāya kalpate' atra sambandhaśrvaturthyarthaḥ | bhaktikartṛkā jñānasaṃbanvinī utpattiriti bodhaḥ |tādarthyacaturthyāstu bhaktikartṛkājñānajanikotpattiriti bodhaḥ | prakṛtivikṛtyorbhedavivakṣāyāṃ vikṛtivācakāccaturthi | abhedavivakṣāyāṃ tu kartṛtvāt pratharmava, 'bhaktirjñānaṃ kalpate' ityādīti |
analyzed: bhaktiḥ jñānāya kalpate atra bhakti kartṛkā jñāna saṃbanvinī utpattiḥ iti bodhaḥ tādarthya caturthyāḥ tu bhakti kartṛkā jñāna janikā utpattiḥ iti bodhaḥ prakṛti vikṛtyoḥ bheda vivakṣāyām abheda vivakṣāyām tu kartṛ tvāt bhaktiḥ jñānam kalpate ityādi iti

original: yadā tu "janikarttuḥ" [2|4|30] ityapādānatvavivakṣā, tadā pañcamī | bhakterjñānaṃ kalpata iti | jñānasyābhihitakartṛtvātataḥ prathamaiva |
analyzed: yadā tu jani karttuḥ iti apādānatva vivakṣā tadā pañcamī bhakteḥ jñānam kalpate iti jñānasya abhihita kartṛ tvāt tatas prathamā eva

original: atredaṃ tattvam--'kalpate' ityadeḥ 'pariṇamate' ityarthaḥ | pariṇāmaśca rūpāntaraprāptiḥ | tadekadeśe rūpāntare jñānādervikāravācakasyābhedenānvaye dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyām 'klṛpi saṃpadyamāne ca' ityanena caturthī vidhīyate | kvṛptyarthadhātuyoge utpadyamānārthavācakāccaturthotyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atra idam tattvam kalpate iti adeḥ pariṇamate iti arthaḥ pariṇāmaḥ ca rūpa antara prāptiḥ tad eka deśe rūpa antare jñāna ādeḥ vikāra vācakasya abhedena anvaye dvitīyāyām prāptāyām saṃpadyamāne ca iti anena caturthī vidhīyate utpadyamāna artha vācakāt caturthā iti arthaḥ

original: evañcātra caritārthā caturthī caturthī tayorabhedavivakṣāyāṃ paratvāt prathamayā bādhyate | kalpāderutpattimātrārthatve uktarūtyā pañcamyādītyāhuḥ |
analyzed: evam ca atra caritārthā caturthī caturthī tayoḥ abheda vivakṣāyām paratvāt prathamayā bādhyate kalpa ādeḥ utpatti mātra artha tve ukta rūtyā pañcamyādi iti āhuḥ

original: vātaya kapulā vidyudityatra jñāpakatvarūpaḥ | sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | vātajñāpikā tapilā vidyuditi bodhaḥ | atra 'utpātena jñāpite ca' ityanena caturthī | prāṇināṃ śubhāśubhasūcako vikāra utpātaḥ |
analyzed: kapulā vidyut iti atra jñāpaka tva rūpaḥ sambandhaḥ caturthī arthaḥ vāta jñāpikā tapilā vidyut iti bodhaḥ atra utpātena jñāpite ca iti anena caturthī prāṇinām śubha aśubha sūcakaḥ vikāraḥ utpātaḥ

original: 'viprāya hitam' atra sambandhaśrvatuthyarthaḥ | iṣṭasādhanaṃ hitapadārthaḥ | viprasambandhīṣṭasādhanamiti bodhaḥ | 'haraye namaḥ' atra "namaḥ svastisvāhāsvacālaṃvaṣaḍayogācva" [2|3|16] iti sūtraṇa caturyī | namaḥśabdārtho natiḥ | sā cāpakṛṣṭaclajñānabodhānukūlo vyāpāraḥ | tatrāpakarṣako vyāpāraśca namaḥṣabdena, vyutpattivaiciñyāt |
analyzed: viprāya hitam atra sambandha śrva tuthī arthaḥ iṣṭa sādhanam hita padārthaḥ vipra sambandhi iṣṭa sādhanam iti bodhaḥ haraye namaḥ atra namaḥ iti sūtraṇa caturyī namaḥ śabda arthaḥ natiḥ sā ca apakṛṣṭa cla jñāna bodha anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ tatra apakarṣakaḥ vyāpāraḥ ca namaḥ śabdena vyutpatti vaiciñyāt

original: svaprayoktṛpuruṣaviśeṣāśrayatvanamaskāryāvadhitvoparakta eva pratīyate | anyoccāritapadnānyadiyanatyabodhanāt | sa ca vyāpāraḥ karaśiraḥsaṃyogādiḥ kvacit, kvacidīdṛśaśabdaprayoga eva | tthā ca haryavadhikasvaniṣṭhāpakṛṣṭatvajñānabodhānukūlaḥ prayoktṛniṣṭho vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: sva prayoktṛ puruṣa viśeṣa āśraya tva namaskārya avadhi tva uparaktaḥ eva pratīyate sa ca vyāpāraḥ kara śiraḥ saṃyoga ādiḥ kvacid kvacid īdṛśa śabda prayogaḥ eva tthā ca hari avadhika sva niṣṭha apakṛṣṭa tva jñāna bodha anukūlaḥ prayoktṛ niṣṭhaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: 'eṣo'rghyaḥ śivāya namaḥ' ityādau tyāgo namaḥśabdārthaḥ | tyāgaśrva śivasvatvasvasvatvanivṛttyubhayānukūlo vyāpāraviśeṣarūpaḥ | śivaḥ svaṃ na pratigṛhṇīyādityādiprāmāṇyena dravye devatāyā api svakārāt |
analyzed: eṣaḥ arghyaḥ śivāya namaḥ ityādau tyāgaḥ namaḥ śabda arthaḥ śiva svatva sva sva tva nivṛtti ubhaya anukūlaḥ vyāpāra viśeṣa rūpaḥ śivaḥ svam na pratigṛhṇīyāt ityādi prāmāṇyena dravye devatāyāḥ api svakārāt

original: caturthyarthaśrvoddeśyatvarūpaḥ sambandhaḥ | uddeśyatvañca viṣayatāviśeṣarūpam | evañca śivoddeśyakatyāgaviṣayo'rghya iti bodhaḥ | acetanadevatāpakṣe tu svasvatvābhāvānukūlavyāpārastyāgaḥ | sa ca vedabodhitasvaprayogakartṛ katvoparakta eva pratīyate, vyutpattivaicitryāt | anyoccāritanamaḥ pradenānyadīyatyāgāpratīteḥ |
analyzed: sambandhaḥ uddeśya tvañca viṣayatā viśeṣa rūpam evam ca śiva uddeśyaka tyāga viṣayaḥ iti bodhaḥ acetana devatā pakṣe tu sva svatva abhāva anukūla vyāpāraḥ tyāgaḥ sa ca veda bodhita sva prayoga kartṛ katva uparaktaḥ eva pratīyate vyutpatti vaicitryāt anya uccārita namaḥ pradena anyadīya tyāga apratīteḥ

original: ṛtvigbhaśrva yajamānīyatattadamaddravye sviyatvamāropyeva namaḥśabdaḥ prayujyata iti na doṣaḥ |saṃpradānacaturthī tvatra nāśaṅkacā, namaḥpadārthasya kriyātvābhāvāt | vedabodhitetyukterna nīcoddeśyake teyāge namaḥśabdaprayogā ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: sviya tvam āropya iva namaḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate iti na doṣaḥ saṃpradāna caturthī tu atra na āśaṅkacā namaḥ padārthasya kriyā tva abhāvāt veda bodhitā iti ukteḥ na nīca uddeśyake namaḥ śabda prayogāḥ iti āhuḥ

original: namaskaroti devān ityatra 'upapadavibhaktoḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī' iti nyāyāt karmatvena dvitīyā | dhātvarthasya pradhānatvena nāmārthasya cāpradhānatvena pradhānāpradhānayośca pradhānanimittakārthasyaivaucityamiti hi tannyāyabījam
analyzed: namaskaroti devān iti atra upapada vibhaktoḥ kāraka vibhaktiḥ balīyasī iti nyāyāt karma tvena dvitīyā dhātvarthasya pradhāna tvena nāma arthasya ca apradhāna tvena pradhāna apradhānayoḥ ca pradhāna nimittaka arthasya eva aucityam iti hi tad nyāya bījam

original: nanu kathamatra karmatvaṃ devānām, na ca svaniṣṭhāpakṛṣṭatvajñānabodhānukūlavyāpārarūpanamaskāraphalasya tādṛśajñānabodhasyāśrayatvāt ttvamiti vācyam, prekṣitustaṭasthāderapi karmatvāpatteriti cet, na: svaviṣayaviṣayāvadhitvasamānādhikaraṇasamavāyasya phalatāvacchedakasambanvatvādadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: nanu katham atra karmatvam devānām na ca sva niṣṭha apakṛṣṭatva jñāna bodha anukūla vyāpāra rūpa namaskāra phalasya tādṛśa jñāna bodhasya āśraya tvāt ttvam iti vācyam prekṣituḥ taṭastha ādeḥ api karmatva āpatteḥ iti ced na sva viṣaya viṣaya avadhitva samāna adhikaraṇa samavāyasya phalatā avacchedaka sambanva tvāt adoṣaḥ

original: svam=apakṛṣṭatvajñānarūpaṃ phalam, avadhitāsambandhenāpakarṣāśrayatvāt karmatvamityanye |
analyzed: svam apakṛṣṭa tva jñāna rūpam phalam avadhitā sambandhena apakarṣa āśraya tvāt karmatvam iti anye

original: nanvenamapi 'hareya namaḥ' ityādyanurodhānnamasśabdasya vācakatvāvaśyakatvād namasśabdārthabodhāśrayatve'pi dhātvarthaphalāśrayatvābhāvāt kathaṃ karmatvamiti cet, na: sākṣātprabhṛtiṣu paṭhitasya kṛñyoge nipātādisaṃjñakasya dyotakatvāṅgīkārādadoṣaḥ | 'haraye namaḥ' ityādo tu svarādipaṭhitaḥ, prakṛte tu na saḥ | ata eva satvasamāsādisiddhiḥ |
analyzed: nanu enam api hareya namaḥ ityādi anurodhāt namaḥ śabdasya vācakatva āvaśyakatvāt namaḥ śabda artha bodha āśraya tve api dhātvartha phala āśraya tva abhāvāt katham karmatvam iti ced na sākṣāt prabhṛtiṣu paṭhitasya kṛñ yoge nipāta ādi saṃjñakasya dyotaka tva aṅgīkārāt adoṣaḥ haraye namaḥ ityādau tu svara ādi paṭhitaḥ prakṛte tu na saḥ atas eva sattva samāsa ādi siddhiḥ

original: na caivamapi namasśabdārthānvayābhāvenopapadavibhaktoḥ kathaṃ prāptiḥ, taddyotyānvayamātreṇa tatprāpteḥ | yadā tu karmaṇo'pyasya śeṣatvena vivakṣā, tadā ṣaṣṭhiṃ bādhitvā "namaḥsvasti" iti caturthī eva |
analyzed: na ca evam api namaḥ śabda artha anvaya abhāvena upapada vibhaktoḥ katham prāptiḥ tad dyotya anvaya mātreṇa tad prāpteḥ yadā tu karmaṇā upi asya śeṣa tvena vivakṣā tadā bādhitvā namaḥ svasti iti caturthī eva

original: yattu, ekasyā evopapadavibhaktitve, kārakavibhaktitve cāyaṃ nyāya iti | tat, na : "namovarivaḥ" [3|2|22] iti sūtrasthabhāṣyavirodhāt | tatra hi 'namasyati devān' ityatra caturthīvāraṇāyāyaṃ nyāya upanyasto bhagavatā | etena svastisāhacaryāt satvavācakanamasśabdasyaiva grahaṇam |
analyzed: yat tu ekasyāḥ eva upapada vibhakti tve kāraka vibhakti tve ca ayam nyāyaḥ iti tat na namaḥ varivaḥ iti sūtra stha bhāṣya virodhāt tatra hi namasyati devān iti atra caturthī vāraṇāya ayam nyāyaḥ upanyastaḥ bhagavatā etena svasti sāhacaryāt satva vācaka namaḥ śabdasya eva grahaṇam

original: 'namasaskaroti' ityādau na sattvavācakaḥ, satvakaraṇena nipātasaṃjñakatvāditi parāstam | namasyatītyādāvapi kriyāvācakatvenāsattvavācakatvādaprāptau bhāṣyavirodhāpateḥ |
analyzed: namasaskaroti ityādau na sattva vācakaḥ satva karaṇena nipāta saṃjñaka tvāt iti parāstam namasyati ityādau api kriyā vācaka tvena asattva vācaka tvāt aprāptau bhāṣya virodha āpateḥ

original: yogagrahaṇenaitadyogamātre curthīvidhānena karmatvāvivakṣāyām 'namasyati devebhyaḥ, ityanātteśca | avyayamiti mahāsañjñayā svarādipaṭhitasyāpi liṅgasaṃkhyākārakānvayitvācceti dik |
analyzed: yoga grahaṇena etad yoga mātre curthī vidhānena karma tva avivakṣāyām namasyati devebhyaḥ iti anātteḥ ca avyayam iti mahā sañjñayā svara ādi paṭhitasya api liṅga saṃkhyā kāraka anvayi tvāt ca iti diś

original: 'prajābhyaḥsvasti' ityādau svastiśabdo maṅgalārthaḥ | sambandhaścaturthyarthaḥ | maṅgalāśaṃmāsthale 'svastyastu gobhyaḥ' ityādau svastiśabdārthānvaye caturthī, kriyānvaye tu ṣaṣṭhī | tatra caturthyante āśaṃsāviṣayagosambandhimaṅgalakartṛkaṃ bhavanamiti bodhaḥ | ṣaṣṭhacante āśaṃsāviṣayamaṅgalakartṛ kaṃ gosambandhibhavanamiti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: prajābhyaḥ svasti ityādau svasti śabdaḥ maṅgala arthaḥ sambandhaḥ caturthī arthaḥ maṅgala āśaṃmā sthale svasti astu gobhyaḥ ityādau svasti śabda artha anvaye caturthī kriyā anvaye tu ṣaṣṭhī tatra caturthī ante āśaṃsā viṣaya go sambandhi maṅgala kartṛkam bhavanam iti bodhaḥ ṣaṣṭha cante āśaṃsā viṣaya maṅgala kartṛ kam go sambandhi bhavanam iti bodhaḥ

original: yattu, 'āśīḥ svastiśabdarthaḥ, sā ca parahitaviṣayiṇīcchā, hitānvāyīsambandhaścaturthyartha iti | tat, na :bhūyādityāśīrliṅādeḥ prayogānāpatteḥ, svasti vṛṣalāyetyādau caturthyanāpatteśca, aṅgīkārārtho hi tatra svastiśabdaḥ | maṅgalāṅgīkārārthatvasyaiva prāmāṇikairuktośceti dik |
analyzed: yat tu āśīḥ svasti śabda arthaḥ sā ca para hita viṣayiṇī icchā hita anvāyī sambandhaḥ caturthī arthaḥ iti tat na bhūyāt iti āśīḥ liṅ ādeḥ prayoga anāpatteḥ svasti vṛṣalāya ityādau caturthī anāpatteḥ ca aṅgīkāra arthaḥ hi tatra svasti śabdaḥ maṅgala aṅgīkāra ārtha tvasya eva prāmāṇikaiḥ uktoḥ ca iti diś

original: svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭśabdastyāgārtakanamasśabdena vyākhyātāḥ |
analyzed: svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ śabdaḥ tyāga ārtaka namaḥ śabdena vyākhyātāḥ

original: 'gaityebhyo hariralam' ityatralamśabdārthaḥ sāmarthmavān | caturthyarthaśca māraṇādisambandhitvarūpasambandhaḥ | evañca daityamāraṇādisambandhisāmarthyasāmarthyavān iti bodhaḥ
analyzed: gaityebhyaḥ hariḥ alam iti atra alam śabda arthaḥ sāmarthmavān caturthī arthaḥ ca māraṇa ādi sambandhi tva rūpa sambandhaḥ evam ca daitya māraṇa ādi sambandhi sāmarthya sāmarthyavān iti bodhaḥ

original: ityupapadacaturthovibhaktyarthanirūpaṇam |
analyzed: iti upapada caturthaḥ vibhakti artha nirūpaṇam

original: atha pañcamīvibhaktyarthavicāraḥ
analyzed: atha pañcamī vibhakti artha vicāraḥ

original: kārakavibhaktirūpañcamyā apādānamarthaḥ | "apādāne pañcamī" [ 2|3|28 ] iti sūtrāt | tallakṣaṇabodhakañca "dhruvamapāye'pādānam" [ 1|4|24 ] iti sūtram | atrāpāyo viśloṣaḥ sambandhābhāvaḥ | sa ca na vāstavasambandhapūrvakaḥ, kintu buddhiparikalpitasambandhapūrvako'pi | evamabhāvo'pi buddhiparikalpito bodhyaḥ |
analyzed: kāraka vibhakti rūpa ñcamyā apādānam arthaḥ apādāne pañcamī iti sūtrāt tad lakṣaṇa bodhakam ca dhruvam apāya apādānam iti sūtram atra apāyaḥ viśloṣaḥ sambandha abhāvaḥ sa ca na vāstava sambandha pūrvakaḥ kintu buddhi parikalpita sambandha pūrvakaḥ api evam abhāvaḥ api buddhi parikalpitaḥ bodhyaḥ

original: ata eva jugupsādipūrvakanivṛttilakṣakatāmāśritya 'jugutsāvirāma' ityādipratyākhyānaṃ bhāṣyoktam ; "yataśca nirddhāraṇam" [ 2|3|141 ] iti sūtraprayogaḥ, 'yato yato virajyate' ityādiprayogaśca saṃgacchate | tajjanakagativiśeṣo'pyatrāpāyaḥ ---
analyzed: atas eva jugupsā ādi pūrvaka nivṛtti lakṣaka tām āśritya jugutsā virāmaḥ ityādi pratyākhyānam bhāṣya uktam yatas ca nirddhāraṇam iti sūtra prayogaḥ yatas yatas virajyate ityādi prayogaḥ ca saṃgacchate tad janaka gati viśeṣaḥ api atra apāyaḥ

original: 'gatirvinā tvavadhinā nāpāya iti kathyate'
analyzed: gatiḥ vinā tu avadhinā nā apāyaḥ iti kathyate

original: iti harisvarasāt | avadhyanvayayaugyavibhāgānukūlatvaṃ vinā kriyāyā nāpāya śabdavācyeteti tadarthaḥ |
analyzed: iti hari svarasāt avadhi anvaya yaugya vibhāga anukūla tvam vinā kriyāyāḥ tad arthaḥ

original: ayāya iti cāvarttate, anvetīti cādhyāhriyate, tenāpāyānvayi yadapāye dhruvaṃ gatirūpāpāyānāśrayaḥ, tadapādānamiti tadarthaḥ | evañca vyāpāratāvacchedakasambandhena vibhāgajanakaprakṛtadhātūpāttatatkriyānāśrayatve sati āśrayatayā tadupāttaviśleṣānvayi tadapādānamiti phalitam |
analyzed: iti ca āvarttate anveti iti ca adhyāhriyate tena apāya anvayi yat apāye dhruvam gati rūpa apāya anāśrayaḥ tat apādānam iti tad arthaḥ evañca vyāpāra tā avacchedaka sambandhena vibhāga janaka prakṛta dhātu upātta tad kriyā anāśraya tve sati āśrayatayā tad upātta viśleṣa anvayi tat apādānam iti phalitam

original: kartṛ vāraṇāya satyantam, dhāvato'śvāt patati, kuḍyāt patato'śvāt patati ityādisaṃgrahāya prakṛtadhātūpātteti | parasparānmeṣāvapasarata ityādisaṃgrahāya tatkriyeti | 'nivarteta tatastataḥ' ityādau pravṛttyabhāvarūpadhātvarthasya viṣayatāsambandhāvacchinnaviśeṣaṇatayā'vadhau sattvāt tatrāvyāpaptivāraṇāya sambandhaviśeṣaniveśaḥ |
analyzed: kartṛ vāraṇāya sati antam dhāvatā ūśvāt patati kuḍyāt patatā ūśvāt patati ityādi saṃgrahāya prakṛta dhātu upātta iti parasparāt meṣau apasarataḥ ityādi saṃgrahāya tad kriyā iti nivarteta tatas tatas ityādau pravṛtti abhāva rūpa dhātvarthasya viṣayatā sambandha avacchinna viśeṣaṇatayā avadhau sattvāt tatra avyāpapti vāraṇāya sambandha viśeṣa niveśaḥ

original: udāsīne'tivyāptivāraṇāya viśeṣyadalam | sa cārtaādavadhireva | avadhitvañca pūrvoktaviśleṣāśrayatvasamānādhikaraṇaḥ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣaḥ, padārthāntaraṃ vā | tatra viśleṣasya dhātulabhyatvādavadhitvenāvadhiḥ pañcamyarthaḥ |
