original: na ca bhinnaśabdo nānyārthaḥ, ghaṭaṃ bhinatītyādāvavayavavibhāgānukūlavyāpārārthakatvena klṛptatvād bhideḥ ktasya sattvāditi vācyam, ghaṭād bhinatti paṭamityādiprayogānurodhena dhātūnāmanekārthatvena cānyo'nyābhāvaprakārakajñānārthakatvasyāpi svīkārāt | bhedānukūlavyāpārārthakatvaṃ tu na, tasya nityatvāt |
analyzed: na ca bhinna śabdaḥ na anya arthaḥ ghaṭam bhinati ityādau avayava vibhāga anukūla vyāpāra arthaka tvena klṛpta tvāt bhideḥ ktasya sattvāt iti vācyam ghaṭāt bhinatti paṭam ityādi prayoga anurodhena dhātūnām aneka artha tvena ca anyonya abhāva prakāraka jñāna arthaka tvasya api svīkārāt bheda anukūla vyāpāra arthaka tvam tu na tasya nitya tvāt

original: anyo'nyābhāvārthakatvamātreṇa karmaṇa eva kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ ghaṭād bhidyate, ghaṭād bhinna ityādayaḥ prayogāḥ | vibhāgārthakatvābhāvācca na "dhruvamapāye" [ 1|4|24 ] ityanena siddhiratreti bodhyam |
analyzed: anyonya abhāva arthaka tva mātreṇa karmaṇaḥ eva kartṛ tva vivakṣāyām ghaṭāt bhidyate ghaṭāt bhinnaḥ ityādayaḥ prayogāḥ vibhāga arthaka tva abhāvāt ca na dhruvam apāye iti anena siddhiḥ atra iti bodhyam

original: yastu, itaragrahaṇaṃ pṛthaktvārtham | ata eva 'ghaṭaḥ paṭāt pṛthak' ityādau pañcamī | na ca so'nyārthaḥ, pṛthaktvasyātiriktaguṇatvāṅgīkārāditi | tat, na ; tasya guṇatvānaṅgīkārāt | ata eva rūpaṃ rasāt pṛthagityupapadyate | "pṛthagvinā" [ 2|3|32 ] ityādinā siddhatvācca | pratiyogitvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ tu itara grahaṇam pṛthaktva artham atas eva ghaṭaḥ paṭāt pṛthak ityādau pañcamī na ca saḥ anya arthaḥ pṛthaktvasya atirikta guṇa tva aṅgīkārāt iti tat na tasya guṇa tva anaṅgīkārāt atas eva rūpam rasāt pṛthak iti upapadyate pṛthak vinā ityādinā siddhatvāt ca pratiyogitvam pañcamī arthaḥ

original: 'ṛte kṛṣṇāda notpadyate sukham' ityatra ṛteśabdārtho'tyantābhāvaḥ, pañcamyarthaḥ pratiyogitvam ; kṛṣṇaśabdaśca tad‌bhakyādilākṣaṇikaḥ | evañca kṛṣṇabhaktyādipratiyogikātyantābhāvaprayojyaḥ sukhakartṛkotpattyabhāva iti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇād ṛte duḥkhamityatra ṛteśabdārthasya sāmādhikaraṇyenetaratrānvayaḥ |
analyzed: ṛte kṛṣṇāda na utpadyate sukham iti atra ṛte śabda artha utyanta abhāvaḥ pañcamī arthaḥ pratiyogitvam kṛṣṇa śabdaḥ ca tad bhakya ādi lākṣaṇikaḥ evañca kṛṣṇa bhakti ādi pratiyogika atyanta abhāva prayojyaḥ sukha kartṛka utpatti abhāvaḥ iti bodhaḥ kṛṣṇāt ṛte duḥkham iti atra ṛte śabda arthasya sāmādhikaraṇyena itaratra anvayaḥ

original: kṛṣṇātyantābhāvasamānadhikaraṇaṃ duḥkhamiti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇādṛte naraḥ śocya ityatrātyantābhāvavān tadarthaḥ | kṛṣṇātyantābhāvān naraḥ śocya iti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇādṛte na dhumurdhara ityādau bhedavānarthaḥ | kṛṣṇābhinno na dhanurdhara iti bodhaḥ | etadyoge dvitīyāpi yathā ṛte vātaṃ vṛkṣaḥ patitaḥ | atra vātābhāvavān vṛkṣaḥ patanāśraya iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: kṛṣṇa atyanta abhāva samān adhikaraṇam duḥkham iti bodhaḥ kṛṣṇāt ṛte naraḥ śocyaḥ iti atra atyanta abhāvavān tad arthaḥ kṛṣṇa atyanta abhāvāt naraḥ śocyaḥ iti bodhaḥ kṛṣṇāt ṛte na dhumurdharaḥ ityādau bhedavān arthaḥ kṛṣṇa abhinnaḥ na dhanurdharaḥ iti bodhaḥ etad yoge dvitīyā api yathā ṛte vātam vṛkṣaḥ patitaḥ atra vāta abhāvavān vṛkṣaḥ patana āśrayaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: vṛkṣapatane vātajanyatvābhāvalābhastvārthaḥ |
analyzed: vṛkṣa patane vāta janya tva abhāva lābhaḥ tu ārthaḥ

original: anye tu --- svaprakṛtyarthaniṣṭhajanakatānirupitajanyatāpratiyogitvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ | tasya ṛte śabdārtha'bhāve'nvayaḥ | tasyacaṭa patane'nvayaḥ | tasya ca patane'nvayaḥ | evañca vṛkṣakartṛkaṃ vātajanyatvābhāvavat patanamiti bodha ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: anye tu sva prakṛti artha niṣṭha janakatā nirupita janyatā pratiyogitvam vibhakti arthaḥ tasya ṛte śabda artha bhāvenvayaḥ patana invayaḥ tasya ca patana invayaḥ evam ca vṛkṣa kartṛkam vāta janya tva abhāva vat patanam iti bodhaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: 'pūrvo grāmāt' atrodayācalasaṃnihitadeśatvaṃ pūrvatvam | tadekadeśe saṃnihitatve pañcamyarthāvadhitvasyānvayaḥ | evaṃ paścimatvamastācalasanihitadeśatvam | sūryodayadigabhimukhasthitasya savyahastasaṃnihitadeśatvaṃ dakṣiṇatvam | tathāvasthitasya vāma hastasaṃnihitadeśatvamuttaratvam | grāmāvadhikodayācalasaṃnihitadeśa [tvam] ityādi krameṇa bodhaḥ |
analyzed: pūrvaḥ grāmāt atra udayācala saṃnihita deśa tvam pūrva tvam tad eka deśe saṃnihita tve pañcamī artha avadhi tvasya anvayaḥ evam paścima tva masta acala sanihita deśa tvam sūrya udaya diś abhimukha sthitasya savya hasta saṃnihita deśa tvam dakṣiṇa tvam tathā avasthitasya vāma hasta saṃnihita deśa tvam uttara tvam grāma avadhika udayācala saṃnihita deśa tvam ityādi krameṇa bodhaḥ

original: 'caitrāt pūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ' pratiyogitaddhvaṃsānadhikaraṇakālaḥ pūrvaśabdārthaḥ | caitraśabdārthasya pratiyoginyabhedena dhvaṃse pratiyogitayā kāle ca tātparyavaśādavyavahitvādinānvayaḥ, ekasayāpyanekadhā'nvayo vyutpattivaicitryāt | evañca caitrābhinnapritayogitaddhvasaitadubhayānadhikaraṇacaitrāvyavahitakālavṛttiḥ phālguna iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: caitrāt pūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ pratiyogi tad dhvaṃsa anadhikaraṇa kālaḥ pūrva śabda arthaḥ caitra śabda arthasya pratiyogini abhedena dhvaṃse pratiyogitayā kāle ca tātparya vaśāt avyavahitva ādinā anvayaḥ eka sayā api anekadhā anvayaḥ vyutpatti vaicitryāt evañca caitra abhinna prita yogi tad dhvasa etad ubhaya anadhikaraṇa caitra avyavahita kāla vṛttiḥ phālgunaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: 'caitrāt pūrvo māghaḥ' ityādau tātparyavaśād yathāyathaṃ triśadditavyavahitatvādinā kāle caitrasyānvayo bodhyaḥ | prāgabhāvāṅgīkāre tu tadadhikaraṇakālaḥ pūrvaśabdārthaḥ | caitra tu para ityādau dhvaṃsādhikaraṇakālaḥ paraśabdārthaḥ| caitrasya ca dhvaṃse pratiyogitayā kāle cāvyavahitvādinānvayaḥ, tātparyavaśāt prāgvat |
analyzed: caitrāt pūrvaḥ māghaḥ ityādau tātparya vaśāt yathāyatham triśat dita vyavahita tva ādinā kāle caitrasya anvayaḥ bodhyaḥ prāgabhāva aṅgīkāre tu tad adhikaraṇa kālaḥ pūrva śabda arthaḥ caitra tu paraḥ ityādau dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa kālaḥ para śabda arthaḥ caitrasya ca dhvaṃse pratiyogitayā kāle ca avyavahitva ādinā anvayaḥ tātparya vaśāt prāgvat

original: kṛṣṇāt pūrvo valabhadra ityatra kṛṣṇaśabdaḥ svotpattikāle lākṣaṇikaḥ, kṛṣṇītpattikālataddhvaṃsobhayānadhikaraṇakālotpattika iti bodhaḥ | kṛṣṇāt para ityādau kṛṣṇotpattikāladhvaṃsādhikaraṇakālavṛttiritibodhaḥ |
analyzed: kṛṣṇāt pūrvaḥ valabhadraḥ iti atra kṛṣṇa śabdaḥ sva utpatti kāle lākṣaṇikaḥ kṛṣṇī utpatti kāla tad dhvaṃsa ubhaya anadhikaraṇa kāla utpattikaḥ iti bodhaḥ kṛṣṇāt paraḥ ityādau kṛṣṇa utpatti kāla dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa kāla vṛttiḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: prayāgāduttaraṃ kāśītyādau saṃyuktasaṃyogavaddeśatvamuttaratvam | tasya ca pūrvatvadakṣiṇatvapaścimatvādinā tattadrūpeṇa tātparyavaśāt tattatprayogeṣu bhānam |
analyzed: prayāgāt uttaram kāśīti ādau saṃyukta saṃyoga vat deśa tvam uttara tvam tasya ca pūrva tva dakṣiṇa tva paścima tva ādinā tad tad rūpeṇa tātparya vaśāt tad tad prayogeṣu bhānam

original: 'gṛhād gaṅgā mama parā kāśyāḥ saivāparā mama |'

analyzed: ityādau viprakṛṣṭa deśa sthatva saṃnikṛṣṭa deśa sthatve parāpara śabdasya arthau sambandhaḥ tena gṛhau adhika mad sambandhi viprakarṣavatī gaṅgā ityādi krameṇa bodhaḥ mama iti atra tu na pañcamī pratyāsatti nyāyena yasya padasya yatrī itthita ākāṅkṣā tad vācakāt eva tad pada nimitta vibhakti svīkārāt

original: parādipadañcāvādhāveva niyatākāṅkṣam, na sambandhinīti spaṣṭameva |
analyzed: para ādi padam ca avādhau eva niyata ākāṅkṣam na sambandhinī iti spaṣṭam eva

original: prāk pratyagvā grāmāditipūrvādiśabdairvyākhyātam | bhavāt prabhṛti ārabhya vā sevyo harirityatra prabhṛtītyārabhyetyarthakamavyayam | ārambha ādyakṣaṇasambandhaḥ, uttarakālavyāpakatvaṃ cetarakriyānvaye saṃsargaḥ, śabdaktisvabhāvāt | evañca bhavasambandhyādyakṣaṇasambandhīttarakālavyāpakasevākarma haririti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: prāk pratyak vā grāmāt iti pūrva ādi śabdaiḥ vyākhyātam bhavāt prabhṛti ārabhya vā sevyaḥ hariḥ iti atra prabhṛti iti ārabhya iti arthakam avyayam ārambhaḥ ādi akṣaṇa sambandhaḥ uttara kāla vyāpaka tvam ca itara kriyā anvaye saṃsargaḥ śabda kti svabhāvāt evañca bhava sambandhi ādi akṣaṇa sambandhi ittara kāla vyāpaka sevā karma hariḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: ādyakṣaṇamārabhyetāyadau sambandhānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ | ata evādyakṣaṇasya karmatvam | karmatvāvikṣāyāmapi ṣaṣṭhīṃ bādhitvā pañcamyeveti bodhyam |
analyzed: ādi akṣaṇam ārabhyeta ā yadau sambandha anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ atas eva ādi akṣaṇasya karma tvam karma tva āvikṣāyām api ṣaṣṭhīm bādhitvā pañcamī eva iti bodhyam

original: 'grāmād‌vahiḥ' atra bahiḥśabdena samabhivyāhṛtapadārthatāvacchedakānadhikaraṇatatsaṃhita [taḥ] deśaḥ kālo vā tātparyāducyate, tat‌sthaṃ vastu ca | evañca grāmasambandhī grāmatvānadhikaraṇadeśaḥ, tatsthaṃ vastu veti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: grāmāt vahis atra bahis śabdena deśaḥ kālaḥ vā tātparyāt ucyate tad stham vastu ca evam ca grāma sambandhī grāma tva anadhikaraṇa deśaḥ tad stham vastu vā iti bodhaḥ

original: 'apa hareḥ, pari hareḥ saṃsāraḥ' ityatrāpaparī ṛteśabdasamānārthau |
analyzed: apa hareḥ pari hareḥ saṃsāraḥ iti atra apa parī ṛte śabda samāna arthau

original: āmukteḥ saṃsāraḥ, atra maryādā āṅo'rthaḥ | tatra maryādā dvividhā -- kālarupā deśarūpā ca | kālagatamaryādātvañca svaprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakālavṛttiryaḥ samabhivyāhṛtapadārthaḥṣa tadanadhikaramatvam | muktipadañca muktyadhikaraṇakālaprāgabhāvaparam| tatrāṅartho vyāpakatvam | pañcamytho nirupitatvam |

original: vyāpakatvasya svavyapyīyapratiyogyavṛttitvaviśiṣṭāśrayatāsambandhena saṃsāre'nvayaḥ | mukatyadhikaraṇakālaprāgabhāvanirupitasvapratiyogyavṛttiviśiṣṭavyāpakatāvān saṃsāra iti bodhaḥ |

original: [svamuktyadhikaraṇakālaprāgabhāvaḥ1 [fn madhyekoṣṭhaṃ pāṭhaḥ prakṛtānuṇyogī] ] etadarthakayācavacchabdayoge tu dvitīyā |2 [fn ubhasarvatasoḥ kāryīviguparyādiṣu triṣu |

original: yadvā, kārtikīpadena taddhvaṃso lakṣyate | | tasyāśrayatāsambandhena vaiśākhīprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakāle'nvayaḥ | tena vaiśākhoprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakārttikīpūrvavartimāseṣu śītābhāvasattve'pi na doṣaḥ |

original: vyāpakatvañca svādhikaraṇasvapratiyogisajātīyakālaniṣṭhābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakadharmavattvam | svaṃ vaiśākhīprāgabhāvaḥ, sājātyañca svapratiyogipadārtha tāvacchedakatithitvādinā | tena prāgabhāvādhikaraṇayatkiñcid‌daṇḍādiṣu śītābhāve'pi na doṣaḥ |

original: 'ārabhya tasyāṃ daśamīṃ tu yāvat prapūjayet' ityādau tithirakhaṇḍakālaviśeṣarūpaiva, na tu kriyāpracayaḥ, pūjādestāvatkrivṛttitvāsambhavāt | samabhivyāhṛtāvadhipadārthasya yāvattvapratiyogino vyāpakasya ca tattadrūpeṇaiva bhānam, tātparyavaśāt | tena bhāvibhūtavaiśākhyādikamādāya na vyāpakatvahāniḥ |
analyzed: ārabhya tasyām daśamīm tu yāvat prapūjayet ityādau tithiḥ akhaṇḍa kāla viśeṣa rūpā eva na tu kriyā pracayaḥ pūjā ādeḥ tāvat kri vṛtti tva asambhavāt samabhivyāhṛta avadhi padārthasya yāvattva pratiyoginaḥ vyāpakasya ca tad tad rūpeṇa eva bhānam tātparya vaśāt tena bhāvi bhūta vaiśākhī ādikam ādāya na vyāpaka tva hāniḥ

original: vyāpakatvasya svanirūpitavyāpyatāvad‌vṛttiprāgabhāvapratiyogvṛttitvaviśiṣṭāśrayatayā śīte'nvayaḥ |
analyzed: vyāpaka tvasya sva nirūpita vyāpya tāvat vṛtti prāgabhāva pratiyogi vṛtti tva viśiṣṭa āśrayatayā śītenvayaḥ

original: evañca kārtikīdhvaṃsasamānādhikaraṇavaiśākhīprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakālanirūpitasvavṛttiprāgabāvapratiyogyavṛttitvaviṣṭavyāpakatāvacchītamiti bodhaḥ | deśagatamaryādātvañca svasamabhivyāhṛtāvadhipadārthāntarāladeśavṛttipadārthānadhikaraṇatvam | yathā prayāgāt kāśīṃ yāvad āyātītyādau | atra kāśopadena prayāge kāśyantarāladeśo lakṣyate |
analyzed: evam ca kārtikī dhvaṃsa samāna adhikaraṇa vaiśākhī prāgabhāva adhikaraṇa kāla nirūpita sva vṛtti prāgabāva pratiyogya vṛtti tva viṣṭa vyāpaka tā vat śītam iti bodhaḥ deśa gata maryādā tvam ca sva samabhivyāhṛta avadhi padārtha antarāla deśa vṛtti padārtha anadhikaraṇa tvam yathā prayāgāt kāśīm yāvat āyāti ityādau atra kāśa upadena prayāge kāśi antarāla deśaḥ lakṣyate
